paras.en: Together, these results indicate that excess RNA itself can interfere with mitochondrial function, rather than simply causing damage through the body's response to a virus.
paras.zh: 总之，这些结果表明，过量的 RNA 本身会干扰线粒体功能，而不是简单地通过身体对病毒的反应造成损害。

paras.en: The precise mechanism remains unclear, but the researchers have proposed a possible explanation involving electrical charges.
paras.zh: 确切的机制尚不清楚，但研究人员提出了一种涉及电荷的可能解释。

paras.en: Mitochondria produce energy by maintaining an electrical and chemical difference across their inner membranes. This difference helps drive the production of ATP, the molecule cells use as their primary energy source.
paras.zh: 线粒体通过维持内膜上的电气和化学差异来产生能量。这种差异有助于促进 ATP 的产生，ATP 是细胞用作主要能量来源的分子。

paras.en: RNA carries a negative electrical charge. The researchers suspect that when unusually large amounts accumulate near mitochondria, they may disturb the electrical conditions required for efficient energy production.
paras.zh: RNA带有负电荷。研究人员怀疑，当线粒体附近异常大量积累时，它们可能会扰乱高效能源生产所需的电条件。

paras.en: "We think the negatively charged RNA may accumulate around mitochondria and disrupt the electrical balance needed for energy production, although how it happens is unknown," Yang said. "This is a new concept that we are continuing to explore."
paras.zh: 杨说：“我们认为带负电荷的RNA可能会在线粒体周围积聚，并破坏能量产生所需的电平衡，尽管它是如何发生的尚不清楚。” “这是我们正在继续探索的一个新概念。”

paras.en: What the Discovery Could Mean for Aging and Disease
paras.zh: 这一发现对衰老和疾病意味着什么

paras.en: Although the experiments focused on viral infections, the findings raise questions about whether RNA buildup might contribute to other health problems.
paras.zh: 尽管实验的重点是病毒感染，但研究结果提出了 RNA 积累是否可能导致其他健康问题的问题。

paras.en: Abnormal RNA accumulation has been observed in several conditions, including certain cancers, neurodegenerative diseases, and disorders associated with aging. Neurodegenerative diseases involve the progressive deterioration of nerve cells, as occurs in conditions such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.
paras.zh: 在多种情况下都观察到 RNA 异常积累，包括某些癌症、神经退行性疾病和与衰老相关的疾病。神经退行性疾病涉及神经细胞的逐渐退化，如阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等疾病。

paras.en: Because mitochondria are essential for maintaining healthy cells, disruptions to their energy production could potentially contribute to cellular dysfunction in some of these conditions.
paras.zh: 由于线粒体对于维持细胞健康至关重要，因此其能量产生的中断可能会导致某些情况下的细胞功能障碍。

paras.en: The researchers suggest that excess RNA may represent one previously unrecognized source of mitochondrial stress. However, further studies are needed to determine how broadly this mechanism operates and whether it directly contributes to these diseases.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，过量的 RNA 可能代表了一种以前未被认识到的线粒体应激来源。然而，还需要进一步的研究来确定这种机制的运作范围有多广以及它是否直接导致这些疾病。

paras.en: "We think this has quite broad translational implications," Brahim Belhaouari said. "Too much double-stranded RNA or mRNA that cannot be degraded effectively may contribute to disease processes in some contexts."
paras.zh: “我们认为这具有相当广泛的转化意义，”布拉希姆·贝尔豪阿里说。 “过多的双链 RNA 或 mRNA 无法有效降解，在某些情况下可能会导致疾病进程。”

paras.en: Potential Implications for mRNA Vaccines and Future Treatments
paras.zh: 对 mRNA 疫苗和未来治疗的潜在影响

paras.en: The discovery could also provide useful information for scientists developing medicines that rely on RNA.
paras.zh: 这一发现还可以为科学家开发依赖 RNA 的药物提供有用的信息。

paras.en: RNA-based therapies, including mRNA vaccines, work by introducing RNA instructions into cells to produce specific proteins. Understanding how cells respond to RNA, process it, and eventually break it down is important for designing these treatments.
paras.zh: 基于 RNA 的疗法，包括 mRNA 疫苗，通过将 RNA 指令引入细胞来产生特定的蛋白质来发挥作用。了解细胞如何响应 RNA、处理它并最终分解它对于设计这些治疗方法非常重要。

paras.en: By identifying another way excessive RNA can affect cellular health, the findings may help researchers optimize future RNA-based therapies and vaccines. The study does not establish that existing mRNA vaccines cause mitochondrial damage in people.
paras.zh: 通过确定过量 RNA 影响细胞健康的另一种方式，这些发现可能有助于研究人员优化未来基于 RNA 的疗法和疫苗。该研究并未证实现有的 mRNA 疫苗会导致人类线粒体损伤。

paras.en: "Understanding this mechanism could help researchers design and optimize future RNA-based therapeutics and vaccines by better understanding how cells respond to large amounts of RNA," Yang said.
paras.zh: Yang 说：“了解这种机制可以帮助研究人员更好地了解细胞如何对大量 RNA 做出反应，从而设计和优化未来基于 RNA 的疗法和疫苗。”

paras.en: More broadly, the research suggests that controlling RNA levels is important for more than maintaining accurate protein production or managing immune activity. It may also be essential for keeping mitochondria functioning and ensuring cells have enough energy.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，该研究表明，控制 RNA 水平的重要性不仅仅是维持准确的蛋白质生产或管理免疫活动。它对于保持线粒体功能和确保细胞拥有足够的能量也可能至关重要。

paras.en: For the scientists, the most striking result was that even a molecule cells depend on every day can become harmful when it accumulates beyond normal levels.
paras.zh: 对于科学家来说，最引人注目的结果是，即使是细胞每天依赖的分子，当其积累超过正常水平时也会变得有害。

paras.en: "Scientists already knew that too much double-stranded RNA can be harmful," Yang said. "What surprised us was finding out that too much mRNA -- something cells normally need every day -- can also damage mitochondria and interfere with the cell's ability to produce energy."
paras.zh: “科学家们已经知道，过多的双链 RNA 可能是有害的，”杨说。 “令我们惊讶的是，过多的 mRNA（细胞通常每天都需要的东西）也会损害线粒体并干扰细胞产生能量的能力。”

paras.en: Research reported in this study was supported, in part, by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (R01AI143709 to Z.Y.) and Texas A&M University. The content is solely the responsibility of the authors and does not necessarily represent the official views of the NIH.
paras.zh: 本研究中报告的研究部分得到了国家过敏和传染病研究所（R01AI143709 至 Z.Y.）和德克萨斯农工大学的支持。内容完全由作者负责，并不一定代表 NIH 的官方观点。

Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 2026; 123 (22) DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2605194123

articles.title: Massive study of 460,000 people challenges ultra-processed food cancer fears

paras.en: Massive study of 460,000 people challenges ultra-processed food cancer fears
paras.zh: 460,000 人参与的大规模研究挑战了对超加工食品癌症的恐惧

paras.en: - A massive study of more than 460,000 Americans found that ultra-processed foods were not associated with increased colorectal cancer risk overall, challenging a widely held assumption. While processed meat was linked to higher cancer incidence, ultra-processed whole grains and dairy products were associated with lower incidence.
paras.zh: - 一项针对超过 460,000 名美国人的大规模研究发现，超加工食品总体上与结直肠癌风险增加无关，这挑战了广泛持有的假设。加工肉类与较高的癌症发病率有关，而超加工的全谷物和乳制品则与较低的癌症发病率相关。

paras.en: A massive study involving more than 460,000 Americans is challenging assumptions about ultra-processed foods and colorectal cancer. Researchers found that eating more ultra-processed food (UPF) was not associated with a higher overall incidence of colorectal cancer (CRC). However, the findings revealed an important distinction: Some types of ultra-processed foods were linked to lower cancer rates, while others were associated with higher rates.
paras.zh: 一项涉及超过 460,000 名美国人的大规模研究正在挑战有关超加工食品和结直肠癌的假设。研究人员发现，吃更多的超加工食品（UPF）与结直肠癌（CRC）的总体发病率较高无关。然而，研究结果揭示了一个重要的区别：某些类型的超加工食品与较低的癌症发病率有关，而另一些则与较高的癌症发病率相关。

paras.en: The research, led by Erikka Loftfield of the National Cancer Institute and published October 15 in the open-access journal PLOS Medicine, suggests that the health effects of ultra-processed foods may depend heavily on what those foods actually contain.
paras.zh: 这项研究由国家癌症研究所的埃里卡·洛夫菲尔德 (Erikka Loftfield) 领导，于 10 月 15 日发表在开放获取期刊 PLOS Medicine 上，研究表明，超加工食品对健康的影响可能在很大程度上取决于这些食品的实际成分。

paras.en: Ultra-processed foods account for more than half of the calories consumed by American adults. These products have attracted increasing scrutiny because of their potential connections to chronic diseases, including colorectal cancer (CRC). Yet the category includes a remarkably diverse assortment of foods, making it difficult to judge their health effects as a single group.
paras.zh: 超加工食品占美国成年人消耗热量的一半以上。这些产品因其与包括结直肠癌 (CRC) 在内的慢性疾病的潜在联系而受到越来越多的关注。然而，该类别包含的食物种类非常多样化，因此很难将其作为单一类别来判断其对健康的影响。

paras.en: For example, some ultra-processed whole grain and dairy products have been associated with a lower risk of colorectal cancer, while processed meats have been linked to a higher risk. This raises an important question about whether the level of processing alone is a useful indicator of a food's potential health effects.
paras.zh: 例如，一些超加工全谷物和乳制品与较低的结直肠癌风险相关，而加工肉类则与较高的风险相关。这就提出了一个重要问题：仅加工水平是否是食品潜在健康影响的有用指标。

paras.en: A Massive Study Tracks Cancer Risk for Nearly 19 Years
paras.zh: 一项大规模研究追踪癌症风险近 19 年

paras.en: To investigate these differences, researchers examined health and dietary records from 461,682 Americans who were between 50 and 71 years old when they joined the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study in 1995 and 1996.
paras.zh: 为了调查这些差异，研究人员检查了 461,682 名年龄在 50 至 71 岁之间的美国人的健康和饮食记录，这些人在 1995 年和 1996 年加入 NIH-AARP 饮食和健康研究时。

paras.en: At the beginning of the study, participants completed questionnaires describing how frequently they consumed different foods. Researchers used these responses to estimate each person's intake of ultra-processed foods.
paras.zh: 在研究开始时，参与者填写了问卷，描述他们食用不同食物的频率。研究人员利用这些反应来估计每个人的超加工食品摄入量。

paras.en: Participants were then tracked through 2018, with a median follow-up period of 18.8 years. This allowed the team to examine how dietary patterns were associated with the development of colorectal cancer over nearly two decades.
paras.zh: 随后对参与者进行了整个 2018 年的追踪，中位随访期为 18.8 年。这使得研究小组能够研究近二十年来饮食模式与结直肠癌的发展之间的关系。

paras.en: The results showed no overall association between total ultra-processed food consumption and colorectal cancer incidence. In other words, participants who consumed more ultra-processed foods did not, as a group, experience higher rates of colorectal cancer.
paras.zh: 结果显示，超加工食品消费总量与结直肠癌发病率之间没有总体关联。换句话说，食用更多超加工食品的参与者作为一个群体并没有经历更高的结直肠癌发病率。

paras.en: However, a closer examination of individual food categories revealed a much more complicated picture.
paras.zh: 然而，对个别食品类别的仔细检查揭示了更为复杂的情况。

paras.en: Some Ultra-Processed Foods Linked to Lower Cancer Risk
paras.zh: 一些超加工食品与降低癌症风险有关

paras.en: The researchers found that higher consumption of whole grains, fiber, dairy products, and calcium from ultra-processed food sources was associated with a lower incidence of colorectal cancer.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，摄入更多的全谷物、纤维、乳制品和来自超加工食品的钙与降低结直肠癌的发病率有关。

paras.en: Meat from ultra-processed sources showed the opposite pattern, with greater consumption associated with higher cancer incidence.
paras.zh: 超加工来源的肉类则表现出相反的模式，食用量越大，癌症发病率越高。

paras.en: The team also examined what might happen when ultra-processed foods were replaced with less processed alternatives. Their analysis found that substituting minimally processed foods for 10% of ultra-processed food intake by weight was associated with a 2% lower incidence of colorectal cancer.
paras.zh: 研究小组还研究了当超加工食品被加工程度较低的替代品取代时可能会发生什么。他们的分析发现，用最低限度加工食品替代 10% 的超加工食品摄入量（按重量计算）可将结直肠癌的发病率降低 2%。

paras.en: These findings suggest that the nutritional characteristics of individual foods may be more informative than simply classifying everything as ultra-processed. Foods placed in the same broad category can have very different associations with cancer risk.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，个别食品的营养特征可能比简单地将所有食品归类为超加工食品更能提供信息。属于同一大类的食物与癌症风险的关联可能截然不同。

paras.en: Why the Findings Come With Important Limitations
paras.zh: 为什么研究结果存在重要局限性

paras.en: Despite the study's large size and lengthy follow-up period, the researchers caution that its conclusions may not apply equally to everyone.
paras.zh: 尽管该研究规模较大且随访时间较长，但研究人员警告说，其结论可能并不同样适用于所有人。

paras.en: Most participants were older, white Americans, meaning the findings may not accurately reflect the experiences of younger adults or more racially and ethnically diverse populations.
paras.zh: 大多数参与者都是年长的美国白人，这意味着研究结果可能无法准确反映年轻人或种族和民族多元化人群的经历。

paras.en: Another important limitation involves how dietary information was collected. Participants reported their eating habits only once, at the beginning of the study. Researchers therefore could not account for changes in individual diets over the following decades.
paras.zh: 另一个重要的限制涉及饮食信息的收集方式。参与者仅在研究开始时报告一次他们的饮食习惯。因此，研究人员无法解释接下来几十年个人饮食的变化。

paras.en: The availability and variety of ultra-processed foods also increased during that time. As a result, the initial dietary assessments may have underestimated participants' actual consumption during the study period.
paras.zh: 在此期间，超加工食品的供应量和种类也有所增加。因此，最初的饮食评估可能低估了参与者在研究期间的实际消耗量。

paras.en: Because the research was observational, it also cannot establish whether particular foods directly increase or decrease cancer risk.
paras.zh: 由于该研究是观察性的，因此也无法确定特定食物是否会直接增加或降低癌症风险。

paras.en: What the Results Mean for a Healthy Diet
paras.zh: 结果对健康饮食意味着什么

paras.en: Rather than treating all ultra-processed foods as equally harmful, the findings support evaluating foods according to their nutritional content and specific health associations.
paras.zh: 研究结果并没有将所有超加工食品视为同样有害，而是支持根据食品的营养成分和特定的健康关联来评估食品。

paras.en: The results also align with existing dietary recommendations for colorectal cancer prevention, which encourage eating whole grains, fiber, dairy products, and calcium-rich foods while limiting processed meat.
paras.zh: 研究结果也符合现有的预防结直肠癌的饮食建议，即鼓励吃全谷物、纤维、乳制品和富含钙的食物，同时限制加工肉类。

paras.en: "In this large population of older US adults, we did not observe an association between total ultra-processed food (UPF) intake and colorectal cancer incidence; however, when we looked at food groups, like whole grains, dairy, and meat, by UPF or non-UPF source, we found that associations were in line with current dietary guidance for colorectal cancer prevention such that higher whole grain and dairy but lower meat intakes were associated with lower colorectal cancer incidence. "
paras.zh: “在美国老年人口中，我们没有观察到超加工食品 (UPF) 总摄入量与结直肠癌发病率之间存在关联；然而，当我们按 UPF 或非 UPF 来源观察全谷物、奶制品和肉类等食物组时，我们发现这种关联符合当前预防结直肠癌的饮食指南，即较高的全谷物和奶制品摄入量和较低的肉类摄入量与较低的结直肠癌发病率相关。”

paras.en: Ultimately, the study highlights why the label "ultra-processed" may not tell the whole story. When it comes to colorectal cancer, the kinds of foods people eat appear to matter more than their processing category alone.
paras.zh: 最终，该研究强调了为什么“超加工”标签可能无法说明全部情况。当谈到结直肠癌时，人们吃的食物种类似乎比其加工类别更重要。

paras.en: The study was funded by the Intramural Research Program of the National Cancer Institute, National Institutes of Health (EL). Additional information about the program is available at the National Cancer Institute website.
paras.zh: 该研究由美国国立卫生研究院 (EL) 国家癌症研究所校内研究项目资助。有关该计划的更多信息，请访问国家癌症研究所网站。

paras.en: Authors LA, CPO, HGH, LML, SZ, RS, and EL are current or former employees of the National Cancer Institute's Intramural Research Program. The funding organization did not participate in designing the study, collecting or analyzing data, deciding whether to publish the findings, or preparing the manuscript.
paras.zh: 作者 LA、CPO、HGH、LML、SZ、RS 和 EL 是国家癌症研究所校内研究项目的现任或前任雇员。资助机构没有参与设计研究、收集或分析数据、决定是否发表研究结果或准备手稿。

articles.title: When will SpaceX and Blue Origin fly to the moon? NASA reveals lunar lander timelines (and an Artemis III update)
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: NASA has revealed new details about its plans to return astronauts to the surface of the moon, outlining a series of upcoming milestones for SpaceX and Blue Origin as both companies race to ready their lunar landers for the agency's Artemis program.
paras.zh: NASA 公布了有关将宇航员送回月球表面的计划的新细节，概述了 SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 即将实现的一系列里程碑，两家公司都在竞相为 NASA 的 Artemis 计划准备月球登陆器。

paras.en: During an Oct. 5 presentation at the Astronautical Congress (IAC) in Antalya, Türkiye, Steve Creech, acting manager of NASA's Human Landing System (HLS) Program, laid out development timelines for both spacecraft, with key demonstrations planned through early 2028 that include orbital refueling and uncrewed lunar landing tests to qualify the vehicles to fly astronauts to the surface of the moon.
paras.zh: 10 月 5 日，在土耳其安塔利亚举行的宇航大会 (IAC) 上，美国宇航局载人着陆系统 (HLS) 计划代理经理史蒂夫·克里奇 (Steve Creech) 列出了这两种航天器的开发时间表，计划在 2028 年初进行关键演示，其中包括轨道加油和无人登月测试，以确保车辆能够将宇航员送上月球表面。

paras.en: A more pressing deadline, however, is NASA's Artemis III mission, which is targeted for the third quarter (Q3) of 2027. Artemis III will launch four astronauts aboard NASA's Orion spacecraft to low Earth orbit (LEO), where they will rendezvous and dock with test versions of both companies' landers for interoperability checkouts. Those demonstrations will help inform NASA's determination about which lander the agency will choose to carry astronauts to the moon's surface on Artemis IV, targeted for early 2028.
paras.zh: 然而，更紧迫的最后期限是 NASA 的 Artemis III 任务，该任务计划于 2027 年第三季度 (Q3) 进行。 Artemis III 将搭乘 NASA 的猎户座飞船将四名宇航员发射到低地球轨道 (LEO)，在那里他们将与两家公司着陆器的测试版本交会对接，以进行互操作性检查。这些演示将有助于 NASA 决定选择哪种着陆器将宇航员搭载阿耳忒弥斯 IV 号登陆月球表面，计划于 2028 年初进行。

paras.en: SpaceX and Blue Origin were both awarded NASA contracts to develop HLS vehicles — Starship and Blue Moon, respectively — and have spent the past several years refining their respective lunar lander designs and dealing with various delays along the way. In the face of those delays, and in an effort to better structure its mission progression for success, NASA overhauled its Artemis program architecture in February to maintain its goal of landing astronauts on the moon by the end of 2028 and establish a more regular cadence of uncrewed landings in the meantime.
paras.zh: SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 都获得了 NASA 的合同，分别开发 HLS 飞行器（分别是 Starship 和 Blue Moon），并且在过去的几年里一直在完善各自的月球着陆器设计并处理一路上出现的各种延误。面对这些延误，为了更好地构建其任务进展以取得成功，NASA 在 2 月份彻底修改了阿尔忒弥斯计划架构，以维持在 2028 年底将宇航员登陆月球的目标，同时建立更定期的无人登陆节奏。

paras.en: As part of that shakeup, Artemis III, previously the program's first crewed lunar landing mission, was moved up a year and repurposed for the lunar lander vehicle tests the agency is preparing to fly to LEO next year. The program's first moon landing remains scheduled for 2028, but was shifted to the manifest for Artemis IV.
paras.zh: 作为此次改组的一部分，阿耳忒弥斯三号（该计划之前的首次载人登月任务）被提前了一年，并重新用于该机构准备明年飞往近地轨道的月球着陆器测试。该计划的首次登月仍计划于 2028 年进行，但已转移到阿耳忒弥斯 IV 号的清单上。

paras.en: Between now and then, both SpaceX and Blue Origin have more than a dozen test demonstrations and vehicle milestones to achieve, including success during Artemis III and flights afterward. This will all lead up to a key decision NASA must make: Which vehicle will carry out the first crewed landing on the surface of the moon since the Apollo program ended in 1972?
paras.zh: 从现在起，SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 都有十多次测试演示和车辆里程碑需要实现，包括在 Artemis III 期间和之后的飞行中取得的成功。这一切都将导致 NASA 必须做出一个关键决定：哪辆车将执行自 1972 年阿波罗计划结束以来首次载人登陆月球表面？

paras.en: Starship reached for the first time on its most recent test flight, which occurred on Sept. 28 from SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas. NASA lists several other important goals for the vehicle to achieve in 2026, including (in the order listed during the IAC presentation) the first return and catch of the rocket's upgraded Version 3 (V3) booster at its launch pad; the first-ever return and catch of a Ship upper stage; the first Starship launch from one of SpaceX's launch pads still under construction on Florida's Space Coast; and, possibly, the first V3 booster reflight.
paras.zh: Starship 于 9 月 28 日在 SpaceX 位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 基地进行了最近一次试飞，这是其首次到达目的地。 NASA 列出了该火箭在 2026 年要实现的其他几个重要目标，包括（按照 IAC 演示中列出的顺序）火箭升级版 3 (V3) 助推器在发射台的首次返回和捕获；船舶上层的首次返回和捕获；第一次星际飞船从佛罗里达州太空海岸仍在建设中的 SpaceX 发射台发射；并且可能还有第一次 V3 助推器的重新飞行。

paras.en: NASA also expects SpaceX to complete the initial build of the crew cabin for its lunar lander Starship variant. SpaceX released renders of Starship's interior last year, as well as images of the test elevator astronauts are using to train for Starship egress on the lunar surface, but little else has been made public about the progress the company has made on the cabin's design.
paras.zh: NASA 还预计 SpaceX 能够完成其月球着陆器 Starship 型号的乘员舱的初步建造。 SpaceX 去年发布了星舰内部的渲染图，以及宇航员用来训练星舰在月球表面出口的测试电梯的图像，但该公司在舱室设计方面取得的进展却鲜有公开。

paras.en: Should the cabin's initial build wrap up by the end of the year, as NASA's presentation suggested, SpaceX will use Q1 2027 to complete integration of the systems that Starship will need to communicate with Orion during Artemis III, and deliver a cabin simulator for astronauts to train on leading up to the mission. SpaceX plans to continue Starship test flights through Q2 of next year, complete a landing leg demonstration and begin crew cabin airlock tests.
paras.zh: 如果舱室的初步建造在年底前完成，正如 NASA 的演示所暗示的那样，SpaceX 将在 2027 年第一季度完成 Starship 在阿耳忒弥斯 III 期间与猎户座通信所需的系统集成，并为宇航员提供舱室模拟器，供宇航员在执行任务之前进行训练。 SpaceX 计划在明年第二季度继续进行 Starship 试飞，完成着陆段演示并开始乘员舱气闸测试。

paras.en: For Artemis III, SpaceX plans to fly one of its existing V3 Starship upper stages, with some slight modifications. Starship and Orion will dock as part of Artemis III but the SpaceX vehicle won't be equipped with a crew cabin for the mission's astronauts to enter. Between the end of this year and the beginning of the next, SpaceX is expected to complete the addition of a docking system and nosecone cover to the Artemis III Starship vehicle, which, NASA documents suggest, has already completed its mechanical fit checks.
paras.zh: 对于 Artemis III，SpaceX 计划飞行其现有的 V3 Starship 上级之一，并进行一些细微的修改。星舰和猎户座将作为阿耳忒弥斯 III 的一部分进行对接，但 SpaceX 的飞行器不会配备供任务宇航员进入的乘员舱。今年年底到明年年初，SpaceX 预计将完成为 Artemis III 星舰飞行器添加对接系统和鼻锥盖，NASA 文件显示，该飞行器已经完成了机械配合检查。

paras.en: Other notches on SpaceX's checklist leading up to Artemis III include the first propellant transfer demonstration with Starship in orbit. As the first-ever launch vehicle and spacecraft designed for full reusability, Starship's fuel constraints require that its tanks be topped off in order to fly beyond LEO. For a moon landing mission, this could mean up to a dozen launches of SpaceX's Starship "tanker" spacecraft to an orbiting fuel depot, which the moon-bound Starship will visit. To pull that off, though, SpaceX has to show it can successfully transfer those cryogenic fuels on orbit, and also store them effectively enough to prevent too much boil-off.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的 Artemis III 计划清单上的其他项目包括首次在轨道上进行星际飞船推进剂转移演示。作为有史以来第一个完全可重复使用的运载火箭和航天器，星舰的燃料限制要求其油箱加满才能飞越低地球轨道。对于登月任务来说，这可能意味着 SpaceX 的 Starship“加油机”航天器要向轨道燃料库发射多达十几次，而前往月球的 Starship 将访问该燃料库。不过，为了实现这一目标，SpaceX 必须证明它能够成功地将这些低温燃料转移到轨道上，并且能够有效地存储它们以防止过多的蒸发。

paras.en: Starship won't require any refueling flights to complete its objectives for Artemis III, but SpaceX is expected to launch its first Starship tanker vehicle within a few months of that mission as it gears up for the Artemis IV moon landing mission. To that end, a launch of an uncrewed Starship lunar lander variant is targeted sometime toward the end of Q3/beginning of Q4, with an uncrewed lunar landing mission carried out before the end of 2027.
paras.zh: Starship 不需要任何加油飞行来完成 Artemis III 的目标，但 SpaceX 预计将在任务完成后的几个月内发射其第一艘 Starship 加油机，为 Artemis IV 登月任务做准备。为此，目标是在第三季度末/第四季度初的某个时候发射无人星舰月球着陆器变体，并在 2027 年底之前执行无人登月任务。

paras.en: Blue Origin, meanwhile, has its own set of milestones to meet as it develops its Blue Moon Mark 2 (MK2) lander — a 52-foot-tall (16 meters) spacecraft powered by three BE-7 engines. Unlike the bare-bones V3 Starship that SpaceX will launch on Artemis III, Blue Origin plans to fly a completed test vehicle, incorporating the crew cabin, partial life-support, flight software and other systems needed to allow astronauts to enter the lander from Orion during their time docked in LEO. Astronauts will be able to enter Blue Moon from Orion to get a feel for the lander in zero-g and test some of its systems.
paras.zh: 与此同时，蓝色起源在开发其蓝月马克 2 (MK2) 着陆器时也有自己的一系列里程碑需要满足——这是一个 52 英尺高（16 米）的航天器，由三个 BE-7 发动机提供动力。与 SpaceX 将在阿耳忒弥斯 III 上发射的 V3 星际飞船的基本结构不同，蓝色起源计划飞行一架完整的测试飞行器，其中包括乘员舱、部分生命支持、飞行软件和其他系统，以便宇航员在停靠在近地轨道期间从猎户座进入着陆器。宇航员将能够从猎户座进入蓝月，感受零重力下的着陆器并测试其一些系统。

paras.en: NASA's timeline shows the company working to complete a series of manufacturing and testing milestones in the last few months of 2026, including continued BE-7 testing and qualification of Blue Moon's BT-7 maneuvering thrusters. The company also faces its Artemis III interim design review and a critical design review for an upcoming landing demonstration mission in 2028.
paras.zh: NASA 的时间表显示，该公司致力于在 2026 年最后几个月完成一系列制造和测试里程碑，包括继续进行 BE-7 测试以及蓝月亮 BT-7 机动推进器的资格认证。该公司还面临 Artemis III 临时设计审查以及即将于 2028 年执行的着陆演示任务的关键设计审查。

paras.en: Blue Origin is also working to restore its pad at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station's Launch Complex-36 (LC-36) to operation and return its New Glenn rocket to flight, following an explosion of the rocket in May that caused extensive damage to the facility. NASA's presentation places that milestone in Q4 2026, a timeline the company has also been very vocal about maintaining. A recent Reuters report, however, suggests that may not happen until early 2027.
paras.zh: 蓝色起源还在努力恢复其位于卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站 36 号发射场 (LC-36) 的发射台的运行，并使新格伦火箭重返飞行，此前该火箭在 5 月份发生爆炸，对设施造成了严重损坏。 NASA 的演示将这一里程碑定在 2026 年第四季度，该公司也一直非常积极地维护这一时间表。然而，路透社最近的一份报告表明，这可能要到 2027 年初才会发生。

paras.en: By early 2027, the company expects to complete the spacecraft's communications systems and finalize its flight software, with assembly, integration and testing continuing into Q2. Q1 2027 is also when Blue Origin's Blue Moon MK1 lander (a smaller, uncrewed version of its MK2 successor) will launch to the lunar surface as a part of NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) program of robotic moon missions.
paras.zh: 该公司预计到 2027 年初完成航天器的通信系统并最终确定其飞行软件，组装、集成和测试将持续到第二季度。 2027 年第一季度，蓝色起源的蓝月 MK1 着陆器（MK2 后继者的小型无人版本）也将发射到月球表面，作为 NASA 商业月球有效负载服务 (CLPS) 机器人月球任务计划的一部分。

paras.en: During Q2 2027, as the Artemis III mission approaches, Blue Origin is expected to complete integration of its test lander with New Glenn and conclude qualification of its BE-7 engine. Throughout next year, the company plans to continue construction and refurbishments at its launch facilities and hopes to have a new launch pad ready to support the upgraded, more powerful New Glenn 9x4 rocket l by the end of Q3. The first flight of that rocket variant is scheduled for Q4 2027, alongside a second MK1 lunar mission and the launch of an uncrewed MK2 demonstration lander.
paras.zh: 2027 年第二季度，随着阿耳忒弥斯 III 任务的临近，蓝色起源预计将完成其测试着陆器与新格伦号的集成，并完成其 BE-7 发动机的资格认证。整个明年，该公司计划继续对其发射设施进行建设和翻新，并希望在第三季度末准备好新的发射台，以支持升级后的、更强大的新格伦 9x4 火箭 l。该火箭型号的首次飞行计划于 2027 年第四季度进行，同时还将进行第二次 MK1 月球任务和无人载人 MK2 演示着陆器的发射。

paras.en: That spacecraft is expected to attempt its own uncrewed lunar landing in Q1 2028, around the same time Blue Origin has scheduled a third MK1 flight. Like SpaceX, Blue Origin will need to demonstrate that its lander can safely reach the moon's surface,operate there and return to lunar orbit before NASA clears it to carry astronauts on a future Artemis mission.
paras.zh: 该航天器预计将在 2028 年第一季度尝试无人驾驶月球着陆，大约在同一时间，蓝色起源计划进行第三次 MK1 飞行。与 SpaceX 一样，蓝色起源公司也需要证明其着陆器能够安全抵达月球表面、在那里运行并返回月球轨道，然后美国宇航局才允许其搭载宇航员执行未来的阿尔忒弥斯任务。

paras.en: NASA's overall timeline remains the same as it has been since the February revamp, with Artemis III expected to launch in mid-2027, followed by a crewed lunar landing on Artemis IV in 2028, and possibly another on Artemis V that same year. There may be changes on the horizon, though. NASA will host a press conference on Friday (Oct. 23) with Administrator Jared Isaacman and Associate Administrator Amit Kshatriya, as well as Artemis program director Jeremy Parsons. During the event, which you'll be able to watch here at Space.com, they will discuss the status of the upcoming moon missions and an "Artemis acceleration."
paras.zh: NASA 的总体时间表与 2 月份调整后的计划保持一致，阿耳忒弥斯 III 预计将于 2027 年中期发射，随后在 2028 年在阿耳忒弥斯 IV 上进行载人登月，同年可能在阿耳忒弥斯 V 上进行另一次载人登月。不过，未来可能会发生变化。 NASA 将于周五（10 月 23 日）与局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 和副局长阿米特·刹帝利 (Amit Kshatriya) 以及阿耳忒弥斯项目主管杰里米·帕森斯 (Jeremy Parsons) 举行新闻发布会。您可以在 Space.com 上观看活动期间，他们将讨论即将到来的登月任务和“阿耳忒弥斯加速”的状态。

paras.en: SpaceX and Blue Origin still face tight schedules to complete their respective uncrewed landing demonstrations before Artemis IV. With SpaceX targeting Q4 2027 and Blue Origin Q1 2028, both are pushing the margins against NASA's hopes to return astronauts to the lunar surface that same year. Which company ultimately gets the green light for that first landing mission will depend on the progress each makes between now and then, and whether their landers can demonstrate the readiness that NASA requires to safely carry astronauts to the surface of the moon and back again.
paras.zh: SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 仍面临着在 Artemis IV 之前完成各自无人驾驶着陆演示的紧迫时间表。 SpaceX 的目标是 2027 年第四季度，蓝色起源的目标是 2028 年第一季度，这两家公司都在推动 NASA 同年将宇航员送回月球表面的希望。哪家公司最终获得首次着陆任务的批准将取决于各自从现在到那时所取得的进展，以及他们的着陆器是否能够证明美国宇航局所需的准备就绪，可以将宇航员安全地运送到月球表面并再次返回。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and space exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions from the Space Coast, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon and more. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Josh Dining) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和太空探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系的演变、太空海岸载人飞行任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划以及人类重返月球等内容。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: Space botanist conducts plant experiments in orbit | Space photo of the day for Oct. 21, 2026
articles.author: Chelsea Gohd

paras.en: Growing plants in space? Yes indeed! NASA astronauts are conducting botany experiments aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
paras.zh: 在太空种植植物？确实是的！美国宇航局宇航员正在国际空间站（ISS）上进行植物学实验。

paras.en: In this snapshot — captured by NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins, commander of SpaceX's Crew-13 mission to the ISS — we can see fellow NASA spaceflyer Luke Delaney hard at work aboard the ISS. And while he's orbiting around our planet aboard a laboratory in the vacuum of space, he's also growing plants.
paras.zh: 在这张由 SpaceX Crew-13 任务指挥官、NASA 宇航员杰西卡·沃特金斯 (Jessica Watkins) 拍摄的这张快照中，我们可以看到 NASA 宇航员卢克·德莱尼 (Luke Delaney) 在国际空间站上辛勤工作。当他在太空真空实验室中绕地球运行时，他也在种植植物。

paras.en: In the photo, Delaney is working petri dishes and experiment modules that support our growing understanding of how plants grow in the microgravity environment aboard the station. Specifically, the experiments Delaney is working on will investigate the genetic responses of plants in this environment.
paras.zh: 在照片中，德莱尼正在操作培养皿和实验模块，以帮助我们不断了解植物如何在空间站的微重力环境中生长。具体来说，德莱尼正在进行的实验将研究植物在这种环境中的遗传反应。

paras.en: This is not the first time that researchers have studied plants in space. In fact, ISS astronauts have conducted a wide variety of plant experiments and investigations over the years. They've grown peppers and other edible produce and even proved that moss can survive outside the station, in the harsh environment of space.
paras.zh: 这并不是研究人员第一次研究太空植物。事实上，国际空间站宇航员多年来进行了各种各样的植物实验和调查。他们种植了辣椒和其他食用农产品，甚至证明苔藓可以在空间站外恶劣的太空环境中生存。

paras.en: When you picture the inside of an orbiting space station, you might imagine the white and gray walls with computers, buttons, switches and other such tech speckling the scene. But the space station is also full of (non-astronaut) life, thanks to the incredible variety of biological experiments onboard.
paras.zh: 当您想象轨道空间站的内部时，您可能会想象白色和灰色的墙壁上布满了计算机、按钮、开关和其他此类技术。但由于空间站上进行了令人难以置信的各种生物实验，空间站也充满了（非宇航员）生命。

paras.en: While space is "the final frontier," and we look outward to study everything from black holes to exploding stars, outer space can also help teach us about own planet. Satellites look back at Earth, studying its changing landforms, migrating wildlife, diminishing glaciers and natural disasters. Onboard the ISS, astronauts conduct experiments with plants, animals, microscopic organisms and an incredible amount of studies supporting human health and medical care. While space might be the final frontier, so much of the work done in space is designed to benefit us back here on Earth.
paras.zh: 虽然太空是“最后的前沿”，我们向外研究从黑洞到爆炸恒星的一切，但外太空也可以帮助我们了解自己的星球。卫星回望地球，研究其不断变化的地貌、迁徙的野生动物、减少的冰川和自然灾害。在国际空间站上，宇航员对植物、动物、微生物进行实验，并进行大量支持人类健康和医疗保健的研究。虽然太空可能是最后的前沿，但在太空中完成的大部分工作都是为了让我们回到地球上受益。

paras.en: Chelsea Gohd served as a Senior Writer for Space.com from 2018 to 2022 before returning in 2026, covering everything from climate change to planetary science and human spaceflight in both articles and on-camera in videos. With a M.S. in Biology, Chelsea has written and worked for institutions including NASA JPL, the American Museum of Natural History, Scientific American, Discover Magazine Blog, Astronomy Magazine, and Live Science. When not writing, editing or filming something space-y, Gohd is writing music and performing as Foxanne, even launching a song to space in 2021 with Inspiration4. You can follow her online @chelsea.gohd and @foxanne.music
paras.zh: Chelsea Gohd 于 2018 年至 2022 年担任 Space.com 的高级作家，并于 2026 年回归，在文章和视频中报道了从气候变化到行星科学和载人航天的所有内容。拥有硕士学位在生物学领域，Chelsea 曾为 NASA JPL、美国自然历史博物馆、《科学美国人》、Discover 杂志博客、天文学杂志和 Live Science 等机构撰写文章和工作。在创作、编辑或拍摄太空作品之余，Gohd 会创作音乐并以 Foxanne 的身份进行表演，甚至于 2021 年与 Inspiration4 一起向太空推出了一首歌曲。您可以在线关注她@chelsea.gohd 和@foxanne.music

articles.title: "A great budget lens for astrophotography, the sharpness produced at f/1.8 and f/2.8 is exactly what you want." Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE lens review
articles.author: James Abbott

paras.en: Excellent image quality, even in the corners of the frame, with minimal distortion. The Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE is well built and comes at an attractive price you can’t ignore.
paras.zh: 出色的图像质量，即使在画面的角落，失真也极小。 Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE 制作精良，价格极具吸引力，不容忽视。

paras.en: Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test and review products.
paras.zh: 我们的专家评审员花费大量时间测试和比较产品和服务，以便您可以选择最适合您的产品和服务。详细了解我们如何测试和审查产品。

paras.en: Dimensions: 3.35 x 4.06-in (85.2 x 103 mm)

As you know, prime lenses come in a wide range of sizes and focal lengths, and every once in a while, one comes along and seems to grab you by the scruff of your neck. One such lens is the Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE, which is an impressive and useful lens for astrophotography thanks to its wide-angle field of view and fast maximum aperture.
paras.zh: 如您所知，定焦镜头有多种尺寸和焦距，每隔一段时间就会出现一款，似乎会抓住您的颈背。其中一款镜头是 Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE，由于其广角视野和快速最大光圈，它是一款令人印象深刻且有用的天文摄影镜头。

paras.en: This lens is one of the wider prime lenses that are available and could be one of the best third-party lenses for astrophotography. With a price of just $464 (£533), this is one of the most cost-effective wide-angle primes, but rather than being a second-rate lens, its build quality and image quality are fantastic. It’s not the best, but it’s undoubtedly a lens you would enjoy.
paras.zh: 该镜头是可用的更宽的定焦镜头之一，并且可能是用于天文摄影的最佳第三方镜头之一。它的价格仅为 464 美元（533 英镑），是最具成本效益的广角定焦镜头之一，但它不是二流镜头，其构建质量和图像质量都非常出色。它不是最好的，但无疑是您会喜欢的镜头。

paras.en: Image quality is excellent overall, with no need for lens corrections, except for vignette removal when shooting wide open. With near-perfect sharpness and minimal distortion and aberrations straight out of the camera, perhaps the weight of the lens is a small price to pay.
paras.zh: 整体图像质量非常出色，除了在全开拍摄时去除晕影之外，无需进行镜头校正。由于直接从相机中输出的近乎完美的清晰度以及最小的失真和像差，也许镜头的重量只是一个很小的代价。

paras.en: The lens is made up of 15 elements in 12 groups and is built like a tank, with an all-metal body. It is pretty heavy, though, weighing in at 19.4 oz (550 g) despite its relatively compact size. Attach this lens to one of the best Sony cameras and you will have a formidable combination. The 16mm f/1.8 is also available in the Nikon Z-mount.
paras.zh: 该镜头由12组15片组成，采用坦克造型，采用全金属机身。不过，尽管尺寸相对紧凑，但它的重量却相当重，为 19.4 盎司（550 克）。将这款镜头连接到最好的索尼相机之一，您将拥有一个强大的组合。 16mm f/1.8 也适用于尼康 Z 卡口。

paras.en: With a focal length of 16mm and a maximum aperture of f/1.8, this is clearly a great lens for astrophotography from a technical point of view. The light-gathering capabilities are excellent, to say the least, and during testing it was possible to shoot at a range of ISO levels with a moonless sky. Even ISO 800 was often high enough for a correct exposure.
paras.zh: 焦距为 16mm，最大光圈为 f/1.8，从技术角度来看，这显然是一款出色的天文摄影镜头。至少可以说，它的聚光能力非常出色，在测试过程中，可以在没有月亮的天空下以一系列 ISO 级别进行拍摄。即使 ISO 800 通常也足够高以实现正确的曝光。

paras.en: The image quality produced by the 16mm f/1.8 is great, with excellent levels of sharpness across the frame. What’s most important here is that even corner sharpness is fantastic when wide open at f/1.8. This is the aperture setting where vignetting is at its strongest, but it reduces drastically when you stop down to f/2.8 and is completely gone by the time you stop down to f/4.
paras.zh: 16mm f/1.8 产生的图像质量非常好，整个画面的清晰度都非常出色。这里最重要的是，当 f/1.8 全开时，即使是角锐度也非常出色。这是渐晕最强的光圈设置，但当您将光圈缩小到 f/2.8 时，渐晕会急剧减少，而当您将光圈缩小到 f/4 时，渐晕会完全消失。

paras.en: Luckily, though, there is a lens profile in Adobe Camera Raw and Adobe Lightroom that completely removes vignetting. There’s also only minimal chromatic aberration and a tiny amount of barrel distortion, which is impressive given the wide field of view produced by the lens.
paras.zh: 不过幸运的是，Adobe Camera Raw 和 Adob​​e Lightroom 中有一个镜头配置文件可以完全消除渐晕。而且只有最小的色差和少量的桶形畸变，考虑到镜头产生的宽视场，这一点令人印象深刻。

paras.en: As mentioned before, sharpness is great wide open and improves incrementally as you stop down up to the sweet spot of the lens, which is f/8. Sharpness drops slightly at f/11, and it’s at f/16 where diffraction begins to soften the image overall. This increases further when you stop down to f/22.
paras.zh: 如前所述，锐度在全开时非常出色，并且当您将光圈缩小到镜头的最佳点（即 f/8）时，锐度会逐渐提高。在 f/11 时清晰度略有下降，在 f/16 时衍射开始使图像整体变得柔和。当光圈缩小到 f/22 时，此值会进一步增加。

paras.en: These latter apertures aren’t relevant to astrophotography; the medium ones aren’t either but the sharpness produced at f/1.8 and f/2.8 is exactly what you want.
paras.zh: 后面这些光圈与天文摄影无关。中等的也不是，但 f/1.8 和 f/2.8 产生的清晰度正是您想要的。

paras.en: The 16mm f/1.8 lens is something of an oddity in one respect: it’s both compact and heavy considering its size, although this comes down to its optical construction. The lens weighs 19.4 oz (550 g) with a size of just 3.35 x 4.06 in (85.2 x 103 mm). It does, however, balance well with Sony A-series cameras.
paras.zh: 16mm f/1.8 镜头在某一方面有些奇怪：考虑到它的尺寸，它既紧凑又沉重，尽管这取决于它的光学结构。该镜头重 19.4 盎司（550 克），尺寸仅为 3.35 x 4.06 英寸（85.2 x 103 毫米）。然而，它确实与索尼 A 系列相机保持了良好的平衡。

paras.en: The 16mm f/1.8 is made up of 15 elements in 12 groups, including four ED glass and three aspherical lenses. The optical construction is designed to deliver sharpness, detail and high contrast with minimal distortion. It’s fair to say it achieves these. Of course, you will experience some perspective distortion when tilting the lens up to capture more of the night sky when there are ground elements in the foreground.
paras.zh: 16mm f/1.8由12组15片组成，其中包括4片ED玻璃和3片非球面镜片。光学结构旨在提供清晰度、细节和高对比度，同时将失真降至最低。可以公平地说它实现了这些。当然，当前景中有地面元素时，当向上倾斜镜头以捕捉更多夜空时，您会遇到一些透视失真。

paras.en: Unlike some wide-angle lenses, the front element isn’t bulbous, and it features an HD nano multilayer coating with a water-resistant and antifouling coating. The filter thread is also just 77mm, so you can easily attach screw-in and square filters if you use them for your astrophotography.
paras.zh: 与某些广角镜头不同，前镜片不是球状的，并且具有高清纳米多层涂层和防水防污涂层。滤镜螺纹也只有 77 毫米，因此如果您将旋入式滤镜和方形滤镜用于天文摄影，您可以轻松安装它们。

paras.en: The minimum focusing distance of the lens is 10.6 inches (27 cm), which is great for landscape photographers but less important for astrophotographers.
paras.zh: 该镜头的最近对焦距离为 10.6 英寸（27 厘米），这对于风景摄影师来说非常有用，但对于天文摄影师来说不太重要。

paras.en: Build quality is impressive thanks to an all-metal body and weather-sealing. This gives the lens a premium look, and it feels robust in the hand. There’s also a useful digital color screen that displays lens information.
paras.zh: 得益于全金属机身和防风雨密封，制造质量令人印象深刻。这使得镜头具有优质的外观，并且握在手中感觉坚固。还有一个有用的数字彩色屏幕，可以显示镜头信息。

paras.en: When it comes to controls, there are possibly a few more on this lens than you might find on the average prime. There’s a manual focusing ring that’s wide enough for use when wearing gloves, a manual aperture ring that can be set to stepped and stepless operation using a switch on one side of the lens, two customizable Fn buttons and an AF/MF switch.
paras.zh: 说到控制功能，这款镜头上的控制功能可能比普通定焦镜头上的控制功能要多一些。有一个足够宽的手动对焦环，可以在戴手套时使用，一个手动光圈环，可以使用镜头一侧的开关设置为步进和无级操作，两个可定制的 Fn 按钮和一个 AF/MF 开关。

paras.en: The Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE is a full-frame lens offering a generous 105.6-degree field of view, allowing you to capture more of the night sky. This lens naturally works with all Sony FE bodies, and if you shoot APS-C, it will give you an equivalent focal length of 24mm. This means if you currently own an APS-C camera but plan to upgrade to full-frame, this lens could comfortably join you on that journey.
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE 是一款全画幅镜头，提供 105.6 度的宽广视野，让您捕捉更多夜空。这款镜头自然适用于所有索尼 FE 机身，如果您拍摄 APS-C，它将为您提供 24mm 的等效焦距。这意味着，如果您目前拥有 APS-C 相机但计划升级到全画幅，这款镜头可以轻松地加入您的旅程。

paras.en: As prime lenses go, this one has a few more bells and whistles than most, so there are a few more things to talk about than usual. Focusing is internal, so the front element doesn’t rotate or extend outwards, which is great when using filters.
paras.zh: 随着定焦镜头的发展，这款镜头比大多数定焦镜头有更多的花哨功能，因此比平时有更多的事情要讨论。聚焦是内部的，因此前部元件不会旋转或向外延伸，这在使用滤镜时非常有用。

paras.en: For astrophotography, manual focus is the only way to go, but this lens also has autofocus for when you’re shooting other subjects. The autofocus isn't the fastest we’ve seen, taking about 0.25 seconds to lock onto subjects when the lens is wide open, or 0.5 seconds when stopped down. This is driven by an SMT stepping motor, which is quiet but audible.
paras.zh: 对于天文摄影，手动对焦是唯一的选择，但当您拍摄其他物体时，该镜头还具有自动对焦功能。自动对焦并不是我们见过的最快的，当镜头全开时大约需要 0.25 秒才能锁定拍摄对象，而当光圈缩小时则需要 0.5 秒。它由 SMT 步进电机驱动，安静但可听见。

paras.en: One feature that you don’t see on many lenses is a small color digital screen on the top of the lens. This shows the focus distance, aperture setting and the active Fn control. Is it a gimmick? A bit. Is it useful? Yes. For astrophotography, the screen is definitely useful because it’s illuminated.
paras.zh: 您在许多镜头上看不到的一项功能是镜头顶部的小型彩色数字屏幕。这会显示焦距、光圈设置和活动的 Fn 控制。难道是噱头？一点。有用吗？是的。对于天文摄影来说，屏幕绝对有用，因为它是发光的。

paras.en: As with most Viltrox lenses, there’s also a USB-C port on the lens mount so it can be powered. This allows you to connect the lens to the Viltrox Lens app via Bluetooth to update firmware and customize the Fn buttons and the digital screen’s welcome screen. This makes firmware updates incredibly easy, which is a great feature to have.
paras.zh: 与大多数 Viiltrox 镜头一样，镜头安装座上还有一个 USB-C 端口，因此可以为其供电。这样您就可以通过蓝牙将镜头连接到 Viltrox Lens 应用程序，以更新固件并自定义 Fn 按钮和数字屏幕的欢迎屏幕。这使得固件更新变得异常简单，这是一个很棒的功能。

paras.en: In online reviews, users consistently highlight the lens's value and image quality. Build quality comes up time and time again, thanks to the all-metal build.
paras.zh: 在网上评论中，用户一致强调该镜头的价值和图像质量。由于采用全金属构造，构造质量一次又一次地得到提升。

paras.en: Many users report that overall, the lens offers much more than you’d expect for the price and even more than some more expensive lenses.
paras.zh: 许多用户表示，总体而言，该镜头的性能远超您的预期，甚至比一些更昂贵的镜头还要好。

paras.en: How we tested the Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE
paras.zh: 我们如何测试 Viiltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE

paras.en: The Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE was tested in combination with the Sony A7R V, which offers an unforgivingly high resolution. The lens was tested at night with a focus on astrophotography, and in daylight to assess sharpness, distortion and general functionality for an all-round approach to testing.
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE 与索尼 A7R V 结合进行了测试，后者提供了无与伦比的高分辨率。该镜头在夜间进行了测试，重点是天文摄影，并在白天进行了评估清晰度、畸变和一般功能，以进行全面的测试。

paras.en: Should you buy the Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE?
paras.zh: 您应该购买 Viiltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE 吗？

paras.en: ✅ You’re on a budget: The Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE is less expensive than alternative lenses offering the same focal length and maximum aperture.
paras.zh: ✅ 您的预算有限：Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE 比提供相同焦距和最大光圈的替代镜头便宜。

paras.en: ✅ You want a wide-angle prime: Thanks to its wide field of view, you can capture more of the night sky, while the fast maximum aperture is ideal for astrophotography.
paras.zh: ✅ 您需要广角定焦镜头：由于其广阔的视野，您可以捕捉更多的夜空，而快速的最大光圈非常适合天文摄影。

paras.en: ❌ You would like flexibility: If you would like the flexibility of a variable focal length, a zoom lens is the only way to go. They are typically slower than primes, though.
paras.zh: ❌您想要灵活性：如果您想要可变焦距的灵活性，变焦镜头是唯一的选择。不过，它们通常比素数慢。

paras.en: ❌ You'd like a wider view: This is a lovely wide lens, but you can get wider options as both primes and zooms.
paras.zh: ❌您想要更广阔的视野：这是一款可爱的广角镜头，但您可以获得更广泛的定焦和变焦镜头选择。

paras.en: Since there are only a few alternatives to the Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE, and given that it offers excellent value for money, this is absolutely a lens worth considering if you need a wide-angle prime.
paras.zh: 由于 Viltrox AF 16mm f/1.8 FE 的替代品很少，而且它物超所值，因此如果您需要广角定焦镜头，这绝对是值得考虑的镜头。

paras.en: Furthermore, you’ll struggle to find a similar alternative with the same balance of overall build quality and price. Image quality is excellent, even in the corners and edges of the frame when shooting wide open with minimal distortion.
paras.zh: 此外，您将很难找到在整体构建质量和价格方面具有相同平衡的类似替代方案。即使在全开拍摄时，即使在画面的角落和边缘，图像质量也非常出色，失真最小。

paras.en: The two customizable Fn buttons and the illuminated color screen that provides useful lens information are extremely helpful when shooting in the dark.
paras.zh: 两个可自定义的 Fn 按钮和提供有用镜头信息的发光彩色屏幕在黑暗中拍摄时非常有用。

paras.en: With a price of $464 (£533) and given its build quality, image quality and overall handling, this lens represents excellent value for money. And while it may be a full-frame lens, APS-C users can still enjoy a 24mm equivalent focal length, so it’s a useful lens for astrophotography whichever format you shoot with.
paras.zh: 这款镜头的售价为 464 美元（533 英镑），考虑到其制造质量、图像质量和整体操控性，物超所值。虽然它可能是全画幅镜头，但 APS-C 用户仍然可以享受 24 毫米等效焦距，因此无论您使用哪种格式拍摄，它都是天文摄影的有用镜头。

paras.en: This is a professional-quality lens with a mid-range price tag, and like other Viltrox lenses, you get the lens, a lens hood, front and rear lens caps and a soft lens case in the box.
paras.zh: 这是一款具有中档价格标签的专业品质镜头，与其他 Viiltrox 镜头一样，您在包装盒中获得镜头、镜头遮光罩、前后镜头盖以及软镜盒。

paras.en: The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.2 LAB FE is a slightly less wide Viltrox lens with a much faster aperture and is part of the company’s flagship LAB series.
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.2 LAB FE 是一款稍宽的 Viltrox 镜头，具有更快的光圈，是该公司旗舰 LAB 系列的一部分。

paras.en: The Sony FE 20mm f/1.8 G is a fantastic wide-angle prime offering excellent image quality in a compact and lightweight form factor.
paras.zh: 索尼 FE 20mm f/1.8 G 是一款出色的广角定焦镜头，以紧凑轻巧的外形提供卓越的图像质量。

paras.en: The Sigma 14mm f/1.4 DG DN Art is something of a beast, both in terms of specs and its size. With a 14mm focal length and f/1.4 maximum aperture, it’s perfect for astrophotography.
paras.zh: Sigma 14mm f/1.4 DG DN Art 无论是在规格还是尺寸上都堪称野兽。具有 14 毫米焦距和 f/1.4 最大光圈，非常适合天文摄影。

paras.en: James is an award-winning freelance landscape and portrait photographer, as well as a highly experienced photography journalist working with some of the best photography magazines and websites with a worldwide audience. He’s also the author of The Digital Darkroom: The Definitive Guide to Photo Editing. www.jamesaphoto.co.uk
paras.zh: 詹姆斯是一位屡获殊荣的自由风景和肖像摄影师，也是一位经验丰富的摄影记者，与一些拥有全球受众的最佳摄影杂志和网站合作。他还是《数字暗室：照片编辑权威指南》一书的作者。 www.jamesaphoto.co.uk

articles.title: Space Nuclear Power Corporation Awarded DARPA Agreement for Ground Test of Autonomous Nuclear Reactor Controller
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M. — October 21, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes) announced today that the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has awarded the company an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program. Managed by Dr. Tabitha Dodson in DARPA’s Defense Sciences Office, the Fat Cat program seeks to advance autonomous reactor operation for national security missions. The contract supports development and ground testing of advanced reactor control technologies that extend the demonstrated capability of American nuclear power.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯 — 2026 年 10 月 21 日 — 太空核电公司 (SpaceNukes) 今天宣布，国防高级研究计划局 (DARPA) 已根据快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划授予该公司一份其他交易协议 (OTA)。 Fat Cat 项目由 DARPA 国防科学办公室的 Tabitha Dodson 博士管理，旨在推进国家安全任务的自主反应堆运行。该合同支持先进反应堆控制技术的开发和地面测试，以扩展美国核电的展示能力。

paras.en: The award extends a continuous line of nuclear power development and builds directly on SpaceNukes’ successful nuclear power demonstration heritage. In 2018, key members of the SpaceNukes team, while employed by Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA, performed the foundational Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology (KRUSTY) work — conducting the only full-power ground test of a new American space reactor in five decades. Under the current agreement, SpaceNukes and Los Alamos National Laboratory will design, build, and conduct a follow-on nuclear ground test of a Kilopower reactor incorporating active control rod operation—an advancement beyond the passively controlled architecture demonstrated in the 2018 KRUSTY test.
paras.zh: 该奖项延伸了核电开发的连续路线，并直接建立在 SpaceNukes 成功的核电示范遗产之上。 2018 年，SpaceNukes 团队的主要成员在受雇于洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室和 NASA 的同时，进行了使用斯特林技术的千功率反应堆 (KRUSTY) 的基础工作——对美国新型太空反应堆进行了 5 年来唯一的全功率地面测试。根据目前的协议，SpaceNukes 和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室将设计、建造并进行后续的 Kilopower 反应堆核地面测试，该反应堆采用主动控制棒操作，这是超越 2018 年 KRUSTY 测试中展示的被动控制架构的进步。

paras.en: “This award recognizes the maturity and continuity of the team that designed, built, and tested KRUSTY in 2018,” said Patrick McClure, COO of SpaceNukes. “We are proud to work alongside Dr. Dodson and Los Alamos National Laboratory to deliver the next demonstrated step in American nuclear power.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席运营官帕特里克·麦克卢尔 (Patrick McClure) 表示：“该奖项是对 2018 年设计、建造和测试 KRUSTY 团队的成熟度和连续性的认可。” “我们很自豪能够与多德森博士和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室合作，在美国核电领域迈出下一步。”

paras.en: The phased program structure includes design, procurement, and integration gates leading to the ground demonstration, producing both nuclear-tested hardware and the engineering basis for autonomous, actively-controlled reactor operation. Integration work will be conducted at SpaceNukes’ workshop in Medina, Ohio, led by Chief Engineer Marc Gibson. The work positions American industry to provide reliable nuclear power across a broader range of mission profiles, including those requiring dynamic power management and rapid response under varying operational conditions.
paras.zh: 分阶段的计划结构包括设计、采购和集成，直至地面演示，生产核试验硬件和自主、主动控制反应堆运行的工程基础。集成工作将在 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的车间进行，由总工程师 Marc Gibson 领导。这项工作使美国工业界能够在更广泛的任务范围内提供可靠的核电，包括那些需要动态电力管理和在不同操作条件下快速响应的任务。

paras.en: “There is no substitute for demonstrated technology when American national security objectives are at stake,” said Andy Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “This award lets us advance the work begun in the KRUSTY program and bring another tested capability forward for the nation.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安迪·菲尔普斯 (Andy Phelps) 表示：“当美国国家安全目标受到威胁时，已证实的技术是无可替代的。” “这个奖项让我们能够推进 KRUSTY 计划中开始的工作，并为国家带来另一种经过考验的能力。”

paras.en: About Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes)
paras.zh: 关于太空核电公司（SpaceNukes）

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corporation was founded on the belief that nuclear power is essential to our future, both on Earth and in space. The company’s goal is to enable the successful deployment of fission reactors in space. SpaceNukes brings together the core engineering and program management team behind the foundational KRUSTY demonstration in 2018. David Poston (CTO) and Patrick McClure (COO) performed this work at Los Alamos National Laboratory; Marc Gibson (Chief Engineer) led the program at NASA Glenn Research Center. The team is joined by Omar Mireles (formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) and Andy Phelps (CEO). SpaceNukes holds a license from Los Alamos National Laboratory for the Kilopower technology and operates from headquarters in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and workshops in Los Alamos with additive 3D printing and in Medina, Ohio, with thermal and vacuum capabilities.
paras.zh: 太空核电公司的成立基于这样的信念：核电对我们的未来至关重要，无论是在地球上还是在太空中。该公司的目标是在太空成功部署裂变反应堆。 SpaceNukes 汇集了 2018 年 KRUSTY 基础演示背后的核心工程和项目管理团队。David Poston（首席技术官）和 Patrick McClure（首席运营官）在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室执行了这项工作；马克·吉布森（首席工程师）在美国宇航局格伦研究中心领导了该项目。该团队由 Omar Mireles（前 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心）和 Andy Phelps（首席执行官）加入。 SpaceNukes 持有洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的 Kilopower 技术许可证，总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，在洛斯阿拉莫斯设有增材 3D 打印车间，在俄亥俄州麦地那设有热力和真空能力的车间。

articles.title: Global Satcom Services Revenues to Reach $145 Billion by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | October 2026 – Global satellite services revenues are forecast to grow 44% to reach $145 billion by 2035, according to the 33rd edition of Novaspace’s Satellite Connectivity and Video Market report. The next decade will mark a fundamental shift in the industry as data services become the dominant growth engine, driving revenues to nearly $100 billion by 2035.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 10 月——根据 Novaspace 第 33 版卫星连接和视频市场报告，全球卫星服务收入预计将增长 44%，到 2035 年达到 1,450 亿美元。随着数据服务成为主要的增长引擎，到 2035 年收入将接近 1000 亿美元，未来十年将标志着该行业的根本性转变。

paras.en: Data services are expected to increase their share of total satellite services revenues from 26% to 68% over the decade, as demand for connectivity accelerates across consumer, defense, government, and enterprise markets.
paras.zh: 随着消费者、国防、政府和企业市场对连接的需求加速增长，数据服务在卫星服务总收入中的份额预计将在十年内从 26% 增加到 68%。

paras.en: While video remains the industry’s largest revenue segment today, future growth will be driven by connectivity. Consumer Broadband, Milsatcom, and Enterprise Networks are forecast to lead market expansion, adding $22.6 billion, $19.2 billion, and $17.2 billion in revenues, respectively, over the next decade.
paras.zh: 虽然视频仍然是当今行业最大的收入领域，但未来的增长将由连接性推动。消费者宽带、军事卫星通信和企业网络预计将引领市场扩张，在未来十年内分别增加 226 亿美元、192 亿美元和 172 亿美元的收入。

paras.en: Milsatcom is emerging as a particularly important growth engine, fueled by rising defense spending and broader adoption of satcom-enabled operational concepts across military forces. At the same time, NGSO constellations are becoming an increasingly important source of resilient capacity for government and defense users.
paras.zh: 在国防支出不断增加以及军队更广泛采用卫星通信作战概念的推动下，军事卫星通信正在成为一个特别重要的增长引擎。与此同时，NGSO 星座正成为政府和国防用户日益重要的弹性能力来源。

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity is moving firmly into the mainstream,” said Dimitri Buchs, Project Manager and Editor of the report. “The rapid expansion of NGSO capacity, declining bandwidth costs, and growing demand for resilient, always-available connectivity are fundamentally changing where and how satellite communications compete.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接正在坚定地成为主流，”项目经理兼报告编辑 Dimitri Buchs 说道。 “NGSO 容量的快速扩张、带宽成本的下降以及对弹性、始终可用连接的需求不断增长，正在从根本上改变卫星通信的竞争地点和方式。”

paras.en: The satellite capacity market is forecast to exceed $46 billion by 2035, more than tripling from 2025 levels. Video Distribution, the largest capacity segment in 2025, is expected to account for just 3% of capacity revenues by 2035. Consumer Broadband and Milsatcom, meanwhile, are projected to represent more than half of total capacity revenues.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，卫星容量市场将超过 460 亿美元，比 2025 年的水平增加两倍多。视频分发是 2025 年最大的容量部分，预计到 2035 年将仅占容量收入的 3%。与此同时，消费者宽带和军事卫星通信预计将占总容量收入的一半以上。

paras.en: Declining bandwidth costs, driven by HTS systems and a growing number of NGSO projects, are accelerating satellite connectivity’s expansion into mass-market applications. Providers such as Starlink are increasingly competing with terrestrial broadband on price, strengthening satellite broadband’s position as a viable alternative to fiber and wireless connectivity in a growing range of markets.
paras.zh: 在 HTS 系统和越来越多的 NGSO 项目的推动下，带宽成本不断下降，正在加速卫星连接向大众市场应用的扩展。 Starlink 等提供商在价格上与地面宽带的竞争日益激烈，从而巩固了卫星宽带在越来越多的市场中作为光纤和无线连接的可行替代方案的地位。

paras.en: The transformation is also reshaping the role of GEO operators. Following a low of six commercial GEO orders in 2024, the market rebounded to 10 orders in 2025, with another 14 recorded by mid-September 2026. The renewed activity reflects evolving multi-orbit strategies and continued demand for GEO capabilities alongside rapidly expanding NGSO systems.
paras.zh: 这一转变也正在重塑 GEO 运营商的角色。继 2024 年 6 个商业 GEO 订单的低点之后，市场在 2025 年反弹至 10 个订单，到 2026 年 9 月中旬又记录了 14 个订单。新的活动反映了不断发展的多轨道战略以及对 GEO 能力的持续需求以及快速扩展的 NGSO 系统。

paras.en: “This is not a return to the traditional GEO model,” Buchs added. “Software-defined satellites, more flexible commercial models, sovereign requirements, and growing multi-orbit strategies are redefining GEO’s role. The future of satellite communications will not be GEO or NGSO—it will increasingly be an ecosystem in which each architecture serves distinct and complementary requirements.”
paras.zh: “这并不是对传统 GEO 模式的回归，”布克斯补充道。 “软件定义的卫星、更灵活的商业模式、主权要求和不断增长的多轨道战略正在重新定义 GEO 的角色。卫星通信的未来将不再是 GEO 或 NGSO，而是越来越成为一个生态系统，其中每种架构都满足不同且互补的需求。”

paras.en: The 33rd edition of Satellite Connectivity and Video Market provides a comprehensive assessment of global satellite service revenues, capacity demand, pricing trends, competitive dynamics, and operator strategies across video, broadband, enterprise, mobility, government, and defense markets through 2035.
paras.zh: 第 33 版《卫星连接和视频市场》对 2035 年之前的视频、宽带、企业、移动、政府和国防市场的全球卫星服务收入、容量需求、定价趋势、竞争动态以及运营商战略进行了全面评估。

paras.en: This edition introduces a granular bottom-up model for Enterprise Networks Back-up terminals, providing greater visibility into market demand and deployment trends. It also features a revised commercial Milsatcom model with deeper analysis by region, frequency band, and infrastructure type.
paras.zh: 该版本引入了企业网络备份终端的细粒度自下而上模型，提供了对市场需求和部署趋势的更深入的了解。它还具有修订后的商业军事卫星通信模型，可按地区、频段和基础设施类型进行更深入的分析。

paras.en: The report also provides an updated assessment of major developments shaping the satellite communications market, including the evolution of NGSO constellations, emerging Q/V frequency bands and other regulatory developments, government and defense spending trends, and the changing competitive dynamics between satellite and terrestrial connectivity.
paras.zh: 该报告还对塑造卫星通信市场的主要发展进行了最新评估，包括NGSO星座的演变、新兴的Q/V频段和其他监管发展、政府和国防支出趋势，以及卫星和地面连接之间不断变化的竞争动态。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。
