articles.title: TechnoMile Recognized as a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Award Winner
articles.author: TechnoMile

paras.en: TechnoMile, the leading AI solution that unifies growth, contracts, compliance, and security workflows, has been named a 2026 Inc. Power Partner Awards winner, recognizing the company among the leading B2B partners supporting entrepreneurs and businesses across the country.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 是统一增长、合同、合规性和安全工作流程的领先 AI 解决方案，被评为 2026 年 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖得主，认可该公司是支持全国企业家和企业的领先 B2B 合作伙伴之一。

paras.en: The annual Inc. Power Partner Awards honor B2B companies that have demonstrated a track record of helping entrepreneurs and businesses navigate the challenges of building and growing a company. From hiring and compliance to technology, infrastructure, fundraising, marketing, and more, these partners provide expertise and services that enable businesses to operate, scale, and pursue their ambitions.
paras.zh: 一年一度的 Inc. Power 合作伙伴奖旨在表彰那些在帮助企业家和企业应对创建和发展公司的挑战方面取得良好记录的 B2B 公司。从招聘和合规到技术、基础设施、筹款、营销等，这些合作伙伴提供专业知识和服务，使企业能够运营、扩大规模并实现其抱负。

paras.en: “Business owners have no shortage of tools at their disposal, and B2B companies need to make clear why their products and services are worth the investment,” says Bonny Ghosh, editorial director at Inc. “The companies on this year’s Power Partners list have done just that. They don’t just have customers – they have superfans and evangelists. Across industries like marketing, financial services, and technology, they’ve proved their dedication to helping fellow business owners grow and succeed.”
paras.zh: Inc 编辑总监邦尼·戈什 (Bonny Ghosh) 表示：“企业主并不缺乏可用的工具，B2B 公司需要明确为什么他们的产品和服务值得投资。今年 Power Partners 名单上的公司已经做到了这一点。他们不仅拥有客户，还拥有超级粉丝和传播者。在营销、金融服务和技术等行业，他们已经证明了自己致力于帮助其他企业主成长和成功。”

paras.en: TechnoMile was recognized for its investment in their clients’ long-term success, solving the persistent challenges that growing government contractors face – identifying the right opportunities among thousands of federal solicitations, managing pipelines through manual processes, lacking visibility to forecast and make confident pursuit decisions, and meeting stringent compliance and security requirements once contracts are won.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 因其对客户长期成功的投资而获得认可，解决了不断增长的政府承包商面临的持续挑战——在数千个联邦招标中识别合适的机会，通过手动流程管理管道，缺乏预测和做出自信的追求决策的可见性，以及赢得合同后满足严格的合规性和安全要求。

paras.en: TechnoMile’s unified platform connects growth, contracts, and security workflows, delivering GovCon, Defense, and Public Sector organizations greater visibility, stronger compliance, lower risk, and more efficient operations. By combining purpose-built technology, trusted AI, and deep government contracting experience, TechnoMile helps organizations compete for, win, and successfully execute mission-critical government work.
paras.zh: TechnoMile 的统一平台连接增长、合同和安全工作流程，为 GovCon、国防和公共部门组织提供更高的可视性、更强的合规性、更低的风险和更高效的运营。通过将专用技术、可信人工智能和深厚的政府签约经验相结合，TechnoMile 帮助组织竞争、获胜并成功执行关键任务的政府工作。

paras.en: “TechnoMile solves a real problem for the contracting market – providing a unified way to manage the full lifecycle of federal business,” said Ashish Khot, CEO of TechnoMile. “This award is a special honor because it is largely based on the feedback and experience of our customers and shows that we are living up to our promise to be a partner for business growth, helping companies better manage the work behind winning and delivering federal business.”
paras.zh: “TechnoMile 解决了承包市场的一个真正问题——提供统一的方式来管理联邦业务的整个生命周期，”TechnoMile 首席执行官 Ashish Khot 表示。 “这个奖项是一项特殊的荣誉，因为它主要基于我们客户的反馈和经验，表明我们正在履行我们的承诺，成为业务增长的合作伙伴，帮助公司更好地管理赢得和交付联邦业务背后的工作。”

paras.en: For more information on Inc.’s Power Partner Awards or to view the complete list of honorees, visit https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards.
paras.zh: 有关 Inc. 电力合作伙伴奖的更多信息或查看获奖者的完整列表，请访问 https://www.inc.com/power-partner-awards。

paras.en: Inc. is the leading media brand and playbook for the entrepreneurs and business leaders shaping our future. Through its journalism, Inc. aims to inform, educate, and elevate the profile of its community: the risk-takers, the innovators, and the ultra-driven go-getters who are creating the future of business. Inc. is published by Mansueto Ventures, along with fellow leading business publication Fast Company. For more information, visit www.inc.com.
paras.zh: Inc. 是领先的媒体品牌，是为塑造我们未来的企业家和商业领袖提供的手册。 Inc. 旨在通过其新闻报道、教育和提升其社区的形象：冒险者、创新者和正在创造商业未来的超强进取者。 Inc. 由 Mansueto Ventures 以及领先的商业出版物 Fast Company 共同出版。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.inc.com。

articles.title: Sudan conflict: Peace efforts resume to end ‘drone war’ fuelling humanitarian crisis

paras.en: Sudan conflict: Peace efforts resume to end ‘drone war’ fuelling humanitarian crisis
paras.zh: 苏丹冲突：恢复和平努力以结束加剧人道主义危机的“无人机战争”

paras.en: Talks to halt the fighting in Sudan and alleviate the humanitarian crisis there continued in Geneva on Wednesday, where nearly two dozen countries convened to discuss a pathway to a ceasefire and transition to peaceful governance that represents all Sudanese people.
paras.zh: 周三，旨在停止苏丹战斗并缓解人道主义危机的会谈继续在日内瓦举行，近二十几个国家聚集在一起，讨论停火以及向代表所有苏丹人民的和平治理过渡的途径。

paras.en: “Our first session, devoted to de-escalation, will offer an opportunity to explore practical ways forward,” said Pekka Haavisto, Personal Envoy of the Secretary-General for Sudan, in a call to delegates to identify measures and use their “respective channels of engagement [to] build confidence and help create conditions conducive to a comprehensive ceasefire”.
paras.zh: 秘书长苏丹问题个人特使佩卡·哈维斯托表示：“我们的第一届会议致力于缓和紧张局势，这将提供一个探索切实可行的前进道路的机会。”他呼吁代表们确定措施并利用各自的“接触渠道来建立信任并帮助创造有利于全面停火的条件”。

paras.en: Now in its fourth year, the conflict began in April 2023 between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) – former allies who had jointly seized power in a 2021 coup.
paras.zh: 苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 和准军事快速支援部队 (RSF) 之间的冲突于 2023 年 4 月开始，现已进入第四个年头，这两家部队曾是盟友，在 2021 年的政变中共同夺取了政权。

paras.en: Deadly drone attacks against civilians and public infrastructure have been a feature of the war and frequently condemned by humanitarian and human rights officials.
paras.zh: 针对平民和公共基础设施的致命无人机袭击是这场战争的一个特点，并经常受到人道主义和人权官员的谴责。

paras.en: “The war in Sudan has become a drone war; it kills mostly civilians,” said Alexandre Fasel, State Secretary of Switzerland, which is co-hosting the meeting with the UN. “Famine-like conditions persist in Darfur, the Kordofan state and elsewhere in the country; it is the war that drives this hunger.”
paras.zh: “苏丹的战争已经变成了一场无人机战争；它杀死了大部分平民，”与联合国共同主办这次会议的瑞士国务秘书亚历山大·法塞尔说。 “达尔富尔、科尔多凡州和该国其他地方持续存在类似饥荒的状况；正是战争加剧了这种饥饿。”

paras.en: Highlighting the protections offered to non-combatants by international law, Mr. Fasel insisted that the Geneva Conventions “are very clear: the protection of civilians and humanitarian access must not wait for a ceasefire and a political solution. Civilians are suffering and dying today.”
paras.zh: 法塞尔先生强调了国际法为非战斗人员提供的保护，他坚称《日内瓦四公约》“非常明确：保护平民和人道主义援助准入不能等到停火和政治解决方案。今天，平民正在遭受痛苦和死亡。”

paras.en: Across Sudan today, almost 34 million people need humanitarian support, according to the UN aid coordination office, OCHA, Mr. Fasel noted. He also cited UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) alerts that eight million Sudanese children are out of school today.
paras.zh: 法塞尔先生指出，根据联合国援助协调办公室 OCHA 的数据，如今苏丹各地有近 3400 万人需要人道主义支持。他还援引联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）的警告称，今天有 800 万苏丹儿童失学。

paras.en: “This is not only a violation to the right of education but an immense risk factor for a future stable Sudan. Conflict-related sexual violence has re-emerged as a tactic to terrorise and humiliate the civilian population, often targeted along ethnicity or perceived affiliations,” he insisted.
paras.zh: “这不仅侵犯了受教育权，而且对苏丹未来的稳定构成了巨大的风险因素。与冲突有关的性暴力已重新出现，成为恐吓和羞辱平民的一种策略，通常针对种族或被认为的归属，”他坚称。

paras.en: In addition to discussing efforts towards a ceasefire, delegates are expected to consider a Sudanese-led “transitional political phase that reflects the aspirations” of the country’s people, by means of “an inclusive and credible dialogue”, the UN chief’s Personal Envoy, Mr. Havisto, said, insisting that “our role is to support the Sudanese in shaping their country’s shared future, with due regard for the diversity of their voices and experiences”.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长个人特使哈维斯托先生表示，除了讨论实现停火的努力外，预计代表们还将通过“包容性和可信的对话”，考虑由苏丹领导的“反映该国人民愿望的过渡政治阶段”。他坚称，“我们的作用是支持苏丹人民塑造他们国家的共同未来，并适当考虑他们的声音和经历的多样性”。

paras.en: The talks, known officially as Consultative Meetings on Enhancing Coordination of Peace Initiatives and Efforts in Sudan, have previously taken place in Cairo twice (June 2024 and January 2026) and in Djibouti (July 2024), Nouakchott (December 2024) and Brussels (June 2025) and Cairo (January 2026).
paras.zh: 这些会谈的正式名称是“加强苏丹和平倡议和努力协调协商会议”，此前已在开罗举行过两次（2024年6月和2026年1月），并在吉布提（2024年7月）、努瓦克肖特（2024年12月）、布鲁塞尔（2025年6月）和开罗（2026年1月）举行。

paras.en: Neither the Sudanese Government nor the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are represented at the meeting in Geneva, as the mechanism was established for mediators to coordinate their actions.
paras.zh: 苏丹政府和快速支援部队（RSF）都没有派代表出席日内瓦会议，因为该机制是为调解人协调行动而设立的。

paras.en: On the margins of Wednesday’s meeting in Geneva, the UN Personal Envoy was also expected to engage with key regional and international partners from the so-called “Quad” mechanism” – involving the United States, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Egypt – and the “Quintet” mechanism of the African Union, the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD), the UN, the European Union and the League of Arab States.
paras.zh: 在周三日内瓦会议期间，预计联合国个人特使还将与所谓的“四方”机制（包括美国、沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国和埃及）以及非洲联盟、政府间发展管理局（IGAD）、联合国、欧盟和阿拉伯国家联盟的“五方”机制的主要区域和国际伙伴进行接触。

paras.en: The current talks followed a day of humanitarian-focused discussions also at UN Geneva that involved delegations, senior UN officials and international non-governmental organizations operating in Sudan including the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) and the Sudan INGO Forum.
paras.zh: 此次会谈是在联合国日内瓦办事处举行的为期一天的以人道主义为重点的讨论之后进行的，与会者包括代表团、联合国高级官员以及在苏丹开展活动的国际非政府组织，包括红十字国际委员会和苏丹国际非政府组织论坛。

articles.title: UN agencies appeal for help to protect weakest from unprecedented El Niño

paras.en: UN agencies appeal for help to protect weakest from unprecedented El Niño
paras.zh: 联合国机构呼吁帮助保护最弱势群体免受前所未有的厄尔尼诺现象的影响

paras.en: “The current El Niño event could be unprecedented in strength – literally, off the monitoring charts that we have used for the past four decades – and will peak towards the end of 2026, but its impacts will be felt long after that,” said Celeste Saulo, Secretary-General of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO).
paras.zh: 世界气象组织 (WMO) 秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛 (Celeste Saulo) 表示：“当前厄尔尼诺事件的强度可能是前所未有的——从字面上看，超出了我们过去四十年使用的监测图表——并将在 2026 年底达到顶峰，但在此之后很长一段时间才能感受到其影响。”

paras.en: According to the latest Global Seasonal Climate Update from WMO, sea surface temperatures in the tropical Pacific – the epicentre of the extreme El Niño weather phenomenon – may rise to 3.8℃ above average between November 2026 and January 2027.
paras.zh: 根据世界气象组织最新的全球季节性气候更新，2026年11月至2027年1月期间，极端厄尔尼诺天气现象的中心——热带太平洋的海面温度可能会比平均水平高出3.8℃。

paras.en: While a Pacific Ocean surface temperature anomaly of 0.5℃ above normal is enough to trigger an El Niño alert by WMO, Ms. Saulo highlighted concerns that the impact of an El Niño fuelled by a 3.8℃ gap has no precedent.
paras.zh: 尽管太平洋表面温度异常比正常水平高出0.5℃就足以触发WMO的厄尔尼诺警报，但Saulo女士强调，3.8℃的温差引发厄尔尼诺现象的影响是史无前例的。

paras.en: Previous El Niños linked to anomalies of 3℃ have brought “very substantive impacts across the world”, but “we are beyond that limit, out of our records, out of our statistics of what we can expect”, the agency chief stressed.
paras.zh: 该机构负责人强调，此前与3℃异常有关的厄尔尼诺现象给世界各地带来了“非常实质性的影响”，但“我们超出了这个限制，超出了我们的记录，超出了我们可以预期的统计数据”。

paras.en: “We are already witnessing extreme weather events and expect this to multiply and cascade as El Niño intensifies,” Ms. Saulo noted.
paras.zh: “我们已经目睹了极端天气事件，并预计随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，这种现象将会成倍增加和级联，”萨洛女士指出。

paras.en: “But a powerful El Niño does not have to be a recipe for humanitarian disaster. We have the science forecasts, the early warnings to save lives and protect livelihoods.”
paras.zh: “但强大的厄尔尼诺现象并不一定会引发人道主义灾难。我们有科学预测和预警来拯救生命和保护生计。”

paras.en: Echoing Ms. Saulo’s appeal for prevention efforts to boost resilience among the world’s most vulnerable communities, the UN’s emergency relief chief, Tom Fletcher, described the new El Niño as a “behemoth…a wrecking ball that will likely tear through Latin America, eastern and southern Africa, Asia and the Pacific with extreme heat, droughts and floods”.
paras.zh: 联合国紧急救援负责人汤姆·弗莱彻响应萨洛女士呼吁采取预防措施以增强世界上最脆弱社区的抵御能力，他将新的厄尔尼诺现象描述为“一个庞然大物……一个破坏球，可能会席卷拉丁美洲、东部和南部非洲、亚洲和太平洋地区，带来极端高温、干旱和洪水”。

paras.en: The next two weeks will be critical to averting a worsening humanitarian crisis linked to El Niño, Mr. Fletcher said, adding that Somalia, Ethiopia and Kenya urgently need funding and emergency supplies in place before heavy rains arrive.
paras.zh: 弗莱彻先生说，未来两周对于避免与厄尔尼诺现象有关的人道主义危机恶化至关重要，他补充说，索马里、埃塞俄比亚和肯尼亚迫切需要在大雨到来之前提供资金和紧急物资。

paras.en: In southern Africa, the priority is to deliver seeds and safeguard livestock, while Central America requires immediate support to protect livelihoods.
paras.zh: 在南部非洲，首要任务是提供种子和保护牲畜，而中美洲则需要立即提供支持以保护生计。

paras.en: Across Asia and the Pacific, countries must brace for a range of climate shocks, including droughts, floods and cyclones.
paras.zh: 在整个亚洲和太平洋地区，各国必须应对一系列气候冲击，包括干旱、洪水和飓风。

paras.en: “It would be an extraordinary failure to see this crisis coming, to hear the predictions from the experts, and yet still squander the opportunity to protect people in its path,” Mr. Fletcher warned.
paras.zh: 弗莱彻先生警告说：“如果没有看到这场危机的到来，没有听到专家的预测，但仍然浪费了保护危机中的人们的机会，那将是非常失败的。”

paras.en: Some 50 million people could face increased hunger because of the weather phenomenon, he stressed, before citing an African Development Bank estimate that it will cost African countries between $10 and $20 billion “and drive down GDP by between one and two per cent”.
paras.zh: 他强调说，由于天气现象，大约 5000 万人可能面临日益严重的饥饿，并援引非洲开发银行的估计，这将给非洲国家造成 10 至 200 亿美元的损失，“并使 GDP 下降 1% 至 2%”。

paras.en: To support resilience efforts, the UN’s top aid official announced that he has released more than $50 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to help 11 countries on the front line, including Chad, El Salvador, Ethiopia, Somalia and South Sudan.
paras.zh: 为了支持抗灾工作，联合国最高援助官员宣布，他已从中央应急基金中拨款超过5000万美元，以帮助乍得、萨尔瓦多、埃塞俄比亚、索马里和南苏丹等11个前线国家。

paras.en: The long-term impact “will be felt for months and potentially years to come”, Mr. Fletcher continued, citing the additional strains placed on the humanitarian system by the global supply chain crunch in the Strait of Hormuz and the Black Sea, respectively linked to war between Iran and the United States and the Russian full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 弗莱彻继续说道，长期影响“将持续数月甚至数年”，他指出霍尔木兹海峡和黑海的全球供应链紧缩给人道主义系统带来了额外的压力，这两个问题分别与伊朗和美国之间的战争以及俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰有关。

paras.en: How is the UN helping the world brace for El Niño?
paras.zh: 联合国如何帮助世界应对厄尔尼诺现象？

paras.en: With a potentially devastating El Niño approaching, UN agencies are helping countries build disaster risk reduction into shelter and preparedness from the start, rather than reacting after disaster strikes. Here are some examples:
paras.zh: 随着可能具有毁灭性的厄尔尼诺现象的临近，联合国机构正在帮助各国从一开始就将减少灾害风险纳入避难所和防备之中，而不是在灾害发生后才做出反应。以下是一些示例：

paras.en: Chile: Shifting rainfall patterns have brought deadly floods to several regions. In northern Antofagasta, the UN Development Programme (UNDP) helped build massive barriers to hold back torrents of mud and debris.
paras.zh: 智利：降雨模式的变化给多个地区带来了致命的洪水。在安托法加斯塔北部，联合国开发计划署（UNDP）帮助修建了巨大的屏障，以阻挡泥浆和瓦砾的洪流。

paras.en: Madagascar: Facing recurring cyclones, the national shelter cluster is developing a strategy that includes a five-year humanitarian action plan, with pilot projects running since early 2025 in the Atsimo Andrefana and Androy regions.
paras.zh: 马达加斯加：面对反复出现的气旋，国家避难所集群正在制定一项战略，其中包括五年人道主义行动计划，自 2025 年初以来在 Atsimo Andrefana 和 Androy 地区运行试点项目。

paras.en: Nigeria: Despite aid cuts, the UN Disaster Risk Reduction office (UNDRR) and the Global Shelter Cluster brought government, humanitarian and environmental partners together in June 2025 to start work on a roadmap for safer shelter in areas hit by conflict and climate shocks.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚：尽管援助有所削减，但联合国减少灾害风险办公室 (UNDRR) 和全球避难所集群于 2025 年 6 月将政府、人道主义和环境合作伙伴聚集在一起，开始制定路线图，在受冲突和气候冲击影响的地区提供更安全的避难所。

paras.en: Yemen: More than four million people are displaced, many of them on land prone to flooding, and flash floods hit over 100,000 households in 2024 alone. The UN refugee agency (UNHCR), UNDRR and partners have backed community-led defences, including a 2.5km flood diversion channel in the Al-Hazm district.
paras.zh: 也门：超过 400 万人流离失所，其中许多人生活在容易发生洪水的土地上，仅 2024 年一年，山洪就袭击了超过 10 万户家庭。联合国难民署 (UNHCR)、UNDRR 和合作伙伴支持社区主导的防御措施，包括在 Al-Hazm 区修建 2.5 公里长的洪水分流渠道。

articles.title: Summit in Samarkand, a boon for child wellbeing and health

paras.en: Summit in Samarkand, a boon for child wellbeing and health
paras.zh: 撒马尔罕峰会为儿童福祉和健康带来福音

paras.en: Representatives from across the international community are meeting in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, to ensure that children everywhere can thrive in a world marred by war, climate chaos and other fundamental challenges.
paras.zh: 来自国际社会的代表齐聚乌兹别克斯坦撒马尔罕，以确保世界各地的儿童能够在饱受战争、气候混乱和其他根本挑战困扰的世界中茁壮成长。

paras.en: The UN-backed World Summit Investing in Children’s Wellbeing opened on Wednesday, bringing together more than 600 participants from over 100 countries.
paras.zh: 由联合国支持的投资儿童福祉世界峰会于周三开幕，来自 100 多个国家的 600 多名与会者齐聚一堂。

paras.en: A child’s wellbeing depends on many factors, including health, access to education, protection from violence, family support and access to help when they need it.
paras.zh: 儿童的福祉取决于许多因素，包括健康、受教育机会、免受暴力侵害、家庭支持以及在需要时获得帮助。

paras.en: In a message to the summit, UN Secretary-General António Guterres stressed that “when we invest in children, we invest in the future”.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在峰会致辞中强调，“当我们投资于儿童时，我们就是投资于未来”。

paras.en: The Secretary-General’s message was read at the opening by Sabine Mahl, the UN Resident Coordinator in Uzbekistan.
paras.zh: 联合国驻乌兹别克斯坦驻地协调员萨宾·马尔在开幕式上宣读了秘书长的致辞。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres warned that progress on child wellbeing is under threat. Conflicts, economic pressures, health emergencies, poverty and climate-related shocks put children at risk, particularly those from vulnerable groups.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生警告说，儿童福祉方面的进展正受到威胁。冲突、经济压力、突发卫生事件、贫困和气候相关冲击使儿童，特别是弱势群体的儿童面临风险。

paras.en: He also noted that humanitarian and development assistance is declining, while developing countries continue to carry heavy debt burdens, which is why the summit is focusing not on a single programme or service, but on systems that need to work together.
paras.zh: 他还指出，人道主义和发展援助正在减少，而发展中国家继续背负着沉重的债务负担，这就是为什么峰会的重点不是单一的计划或服务，而是需要共同努力的系统。

paras.en: Addressing the summit, Khalilur Rahman, the President of the UN General Assembly, called for a sharper focus on turning commitments to children into tangible results, declaring that “a target matters when a child eats, learns, receives treatment and returns home safely.” With only 36 per cent of assessable Sustainable Development Goal (SDGs) targets on track or making moderate progress, he urged countries to accelerate collective action rather than lower their ambitions.
paras.zh: 联合国大会主席哈利勒·拉赫曼在峰会上发表讲话，呼吁更加注重将对儿童的承诺转化为切实成果，并宣称“当孩子吃饭、学习、接受治疗和安全回家时，目标很重要”。由于只有 36% 的可评估可持续发展目标 (SDG) 步入正轨或取得适度进展，他敦促各国加快集体行动，而不是降低目标。

paras.en: He set out four priorities: put children before process; build services and social protection around their needs; reach those furthest behind; and match political promises with financing, responsibility and deadlines. He also called for child-centred approaches to artificial intelligence and other technologies, saying digital transformation should expand opportunity while protecting children from exploitation, discrimination, manipulation and privacy violations.
paras.zh: 他提出了四个优先事项：将儿童置于流程之上；围绕他们的需求建立服务和社会保护；帮助那些落在最后面的人；并将政治承诺与融资、责任和期限相匹配。他还呼吁对人工智能和其他技术采取以儿童为中心的方法，并表示数字化转型应该扩大机会，同时保护儿童免受剥削、歧视、操纵和隐私侵犯。

paras.en: The Assembly President argued that governments should judge progress not simply by improving averages but by closing gaps for children most at risk, including those living in poverty, with disabilities, on the move or affected by conflict and climate shocks. And he challenged governments to make their commitments visible in their budgets: “A declaration cannot vaccinate a child. A promise itself cannot pay a teacher. Applause itself cannot purchase cancer medicines.”
paras.zh: 大会主席认为，各国政府不应仅仅通过提高平均水平来判断进展情况，而应通过缩小高危儿童的差距来衡量，包括那些生活在贫困、残疾、流动或受冲突和气候冲击影响的儿童。他还要求各国政府在预算中明确承诺：“宣言不能为儿童接种疫苗。承诺本身不能支付教师费用。掌声本身不能购买抗癌药物。”

paras.en: The summit was organized by the Government of Uzbekistan in partnership with the Office of the UN Special Representative of the Secretary-General on Violence against Children, child rights agency UNICEF, the World Health Organization (WHO) and the World Bank.
paras.zh: 此次峰会由乌兹别克斯坦政府与联合国秘书长暴力侵害儿童问题特别代表办公室、儿童权利机构联合国儿童基金会、世界卫生组织（WHO）和世界银行合作举办。

paras.en: Minsters, academics and experts are taking part along with civil society and business representatives – as well as children and adolescents themselves.
paras.zh: 部长、学者和专家以及民间社会和企业代表以及儿童和青少年本身都参与其中。

paras.en: Uzbekistan’s First Lady Ziroat Mirziyoyeva said that, according to experts, amid a sharp decline in international humanitarian assistance, the number of deaths among children under five is expected to rise in 2025 for the first time this century.
paras.zh: 乌兹别克斯坦第一夫人齐洛阿特·米尔济约耶娃表示，专家称，在国际人道主义援助急剧下降的情况下，预计2025年五岁以下儿童死亡人数将出现本世纪首次上升。

paras.en: “This is a serious warning to us all,” she said. Ms. Mirziyoyeva also noted that one billion children are growing up in countries most vulnerable to the effects of climate change.
paras.zh: “这对我们所有人来说都是一个严重的警告，”她说。米尔齐约耶娃女士还指出，有十亿儿童在最容易受到气候变化影响的国家成长。

paras.en: In Uzbekistan, where more than half the population is under 30, children’s wellbeing is a government priority. This agenda, actively supported by UN agencies, is also linked to changes in social services and access to early education.
paras.zh: 在乌兹别克斯坦，一半以上的人口年龄在 30 岁以下，儿童的福祉是政府的首要任务。该议程得到了联合国机构的积极支持，也与社会服务和早期教育机会的变化相关。

paras.en: According to UN Resident Coordinator Mahl, preschool enrolment in Uzbekistan has risen from 27 per cent in 2017 to 78 per cent in 2026.
paras.zh: 联合国驻地协调员马尔表示，乌兹别克斯坦的学前教育入学率已从 2017 年的 27% 上升到 2026 年的 78%。

paras.en: More than 10,000 children with disabilities attend mainstream schools and about 1.5 million families receive social assistance.
paras.zh: 超过 10,000 名残疾儿童在主流学校就读，约 150 万个家庭接受社会援助。

paras.en: UNICEF says the share of children living in monetary poverty has fallen significantly, in part thanks to government social support.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会表示，生活在货币贫困中的儿童比例已大幅下降，部分原因是政府的社会支持。

paras.en: In 2025, the country adopted a law to protect children from all forms of violence, as well as an action strategy for 2026–2030.
paras.zh: 2025年，该国通过了一项保护儿童免受一切形式暴力的法律，以及2026-2030年的行动战略。

paras.en: The Samarkand summit also includes the Second International Congress on Childhood Cancer - “From Cure to Wellbeing” - dedicated to paediatric oncology and haematology.
paras.zh: 撒马尔罕峰会还包括第二届国际儿童癌症大会——“从治愈到福祉”——专门讨论儿科肿瘤学和血液学。

paras.en: According to WHO, more than 80 per cent of children with cancer are cured in high-income countries, while the figure is below 30 per cent in many low and middle-income countries.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，高收入国家80%以上的癌症儿童得到治愈，而许多低收入和中等收入国家的这一数字低于30%。

paras.en: In his message, the UN Secretary-General called this “an unacceptable inequality driven by inadequate investment and weak social services.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长在致辞中称这是“投资不足和社会服务薄弱造成的不可接受的不平等”。

paras.en: Cancer is diagnosed in around 400,000 children and adolescents worldwide each year. WHO aims to increase the global survival rate to 60 per cent by 2030.
paras.zh: 全球每年约有 400,000 名儿童和青少年被诊断出癌症。世卫组织的目标是到 2030 年将全球生存率提高到 60%。

paras.en: Children with cancer need more than medical treatment. The State-sponsored institution Mehrli Maktab – which means “caring school” in Uzbek – operates at the Scientific and Practical Medical Centre for Paediatric Oncology, Haematology and Immunology in the capital Tashkent.
paras.zh: 患有癌症的儿童需要的不仅仅是药物治疗。国家资助的 Mehrli Maktab 机构（在乌兹别克语中意为“关爱学校”）在首都塔什干的小儿肿瘤学、血液学和免疫学科学与实用医疗中心运营。

paras.en: Children aged two to 18 can continue their education there during lengthy treatment, studying mathematics, information technology, electronics, music and other subjects.
paras.zh: 2至18岁的儿童可以在长期治疗期间继续在那里接受教育，学习数学、信息技术、电子、音乐和其他科目。

paras.en: They make friends and can discover new interests – many return after completing treatment to see their former classmates. Some former students also attended the summit to share their experiences.
paras.zh: 他们结交了朋友，并可以发现新的兴趣——许多人在完成治疗后回来看望以前的同学。一些往届学生也出席了峰会并分享了他们的经验。

paras.en: Organizers gave prominence to the voices of other children and adolescents. As Najat Maalla M’jid, the UN Special Representative of the Secretary-General on Violence against Children, put it: “They have voices, ideas, expertise, and urgency.”
paras.zh: 组织者重视其他儿童和青少年的声音。正如联合国秘书长暴力侵害儿童问题特别代表纳贾特·马拉·姆吉德所说：“他们有声音、想法、专业知识和紧迫感。”

articles.title: Brilliant sprinter Almeraq retired to stud

paras.en: Brilliant sprinter Almeraq retired to stud
paras.zh: 杰出的短跑运动员阿尔梅拉克 (Almeraq) 退役成为种马

paras.en: Less than a week on from his brilliant exploits in the Champions Sprint, Shadwell Stud have made the decision to retire Almeraq.
paras.zh: 在冠军冲刺赛中取得辉煌战绩后不到一周，沙德维尔·斯塔德决定让阿尔梅拉克退役。

paras.en: Champion sprinter-elect Almeraq has been retired to stand at Shadwell's Beech House Stud for 2027.
paras.zh: 短跑冠军当选者阿尔梅拉克 (Almeraq) 已退役，将在 2027 年站在沙德韦尔山毛榉种马场 (Shadwell's Beech House Stud)。

paras.en: Winner of three six-furlong Group Ones this season for William Haggas and Tom Marquand, that would be a a remarkable season in any book before even considering what happened to him at the end of the 2025 season.
paras.zh: 威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 和汤姆·马昆德 (Tom Marquand) 本赛季赢得了三场六弗隆一级赛冠军，在考虑到 2025 赛季结束时发生在他身上的事情之前，这在任何书中都将是一个非凡的赛季。

paras.en: Running in a Listed race at York in September he clipped heels and took a very heavy fall. Connections feared the worst yet while the horses emerged generally unscathed, neither jockey involved, the now-retired Jim Crowley or Trevor Whelan, have ridden since.
paras.zh: 9月份在约克举行的Listed比赛中，他摔伤了脚后跟，摔得很重。 Connections 担心最坏的情况会发生，而马匹总体上毫发无伤，但参与其中的骑师，现已退休的吉姆·克劳利 (Jim Crowley) 和特雷弗·惠兰 (Trevor Whelan) 自那以后都没有再骑过马。

paras.en: For Almeraq to bounce back this season to not only win races but at the very highest level, shows another side to his character.
paras.zh: 阿尔梅拉克在本赛季的反弹不仅赢得了比赛，而且达到了最高水平，这展示了他性格的另一面。

paras.en: - Ombudsman strikes Champion Stakes gold | Full replay
paras.zh: - 监察员夺得冠军锦标赛金牌 |完整重播

paras.en: - Darkness Falls strikes Dewhurst gold for O'Brien
paras.zh: - 《黑暗瀑布》为奥布莱恩赢得了杜赫斯特金牌

paras.en: The four-year-old by Dark Angel won the Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes at Royal Ascot, the Haydock Sprint Cup by over four lengths and on Saturday he took the British Champions Sprint.
paras.zh: 这匹由“黑暗天使”出身的四岁马在皇家阿斯科特赛马会上赢得了伊丽莎白二世女王禧年锦标赛和海多克短距离赛冠军，并在周六赢得了英国短距离赛冠军。

paras.en: Haggas said: "Almeraq has been a fantastic horse and we have always held him in high regard. He is a strong, powerful sprinter with an iron constitution.
paras.zh: 哈加斯说：“阿尔梅拉克是一匹出色的马，我们一直非常尊重他。他是一匹强壮有力的短跑运动员，拥有钢铁般的体质。

paras.en: "He has done remarkably well to come back from a horrendous fall at York and win three six-furlong Group One races this season, which speaks volumes not only for his ability but also for his mental strength and resilience.
paras.zh: “他表现出色，从约克的可怕摔倒中恢复过来，并在本赛季赢得了三场六弗隆一级比赛，这不仅说明了他的能力，也说明了他的精神力量和韧性。

paras.en: "Combining exceptional speed with versatility, soundness and a lovely temperament, Almeraq has all the attributes to make a very exciting, successful stallion. Everyone at Somerville Lodge wishes him well."
paras.zh: “阿尔梅拉克将非凡的速度与多才多艺、健康和可爱的气质结合在一起，拥有成为一匹非常令人兴奋、成功的种马的所有属性。萨默维尔洛奇的每个人都祝愿他一切顺利。”

paras.en: Racing manager Angus Gold told www.shadwellstud.com: "All of us at Shadwell would like to pay tribute to William Haggas and his fantastic team for the incredible job they did in bringing Almeraq back from what could easily have been a career-ending injury at York last year, and turning him into the outstanding sprinter of 2026.
paras.zh: 赛车经理安格斯·戈尔德 (Angus Gold) 告诉 www.shadwellstud.com：“沙德韦尔的所有人都要向威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 和他出色的团队致敬，他们所做的令人难以置信的工作使阿尔梅拉克 (Almeraq) 从去年在约克很容易结束职业生涯的伤病中恢复过来，并使他成为 2026 年杰出的短跑运动员。

paras.en: "On top of his natural class, he showed how versatile he was by beating the world's best sprinters on fast ground at Royal Ascot in the Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes, easily winning the Betfair Sprint Cup at Haydock on soft ground and then once again showcasing his toughness by running down Paborus on good ground in the Qatar British Champions Sprint at Ascot last weekend.
paras.zh: “除了他的天赋之外，他还展示了自己的多才多艺，在伊丽莎白二世女王禧年锦标赛的皇家阿斯科特赛马会上，他在快速场地上击败了世界上最好的短跑选手，在松软的海多克赛道上轻松赢得了必发短跑杯，然后在上周末阿斯科特举行的卡塔尔英国冠军短跑比赛中，在良好的场地上击败了帕博鲁斯，再次展示了他的韧性。

paras.en: "His remarkable toughness and consistency, together with his outstanding looks, will make him a very attractive proposition to breeders and we are thrilled to add him to the Beech House Stud team."
paras.zh: “他非凡的韧性和稳定性，再加上他出色的外表，将使他对饲养者来说非常有吸引力，我们很高兴将他加入山毛榉种马团队。”
